We run a randomized controlled trial across two Chinese middle schools (N = 1,056), cross-randomizing a six-module AI literacy curriculum with an enforcement intervention that imposes a 30% AI-content cap on writing assignments, detects violations through multi-engine AI screening with instructor verification, and mandates resubmission for flagged submissions. Neither component alone generates detectable academic gains, while the combination of guidelines and enforcement improves writing performance, particularly Chinese writing. The writing gains are concentrated among male students. Compliance outcomes suggest gender-specific behavioral responses to the policy environment. Under guidelines alone, female students reduce measured AI violations, whereas male students' violation rates remain higher than in other conditions. Therefore, guidelines without enforcement, the most common policy responses to AI in schools, may backfire unless accompanied by a well-designed compliance mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项在中国两所中学进行的随机对照试验（N=1,056），交叉随机分配了六模块AI素养课程与强制执行干预（30%AI内容上限+多引擎检测+教师验证+强制重交），发现仅指导或仅执行均不能带来可检测的学业提升，但两者结合显著提高了写作成绩（尤其是中文写作），且效果集中在男生群体。合规结果揭示性别差异化的行为反应：仅指导条件下女生减少了AI违规，而男生违规率依然较高。论文警示没有配套合规机制的指导可能适得其反。
AI.research_question: 学校面对生成式AI采取的两种主要策略——教学指导（AI素养课程）与强制执行（限制AI生成内容占比）——在真实课堂中对学生学业表现和合规行为有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管学校普遍采用指导性准则和强制执行措施来应对生成式AI，但关于这些政策在真实课堂中效果的因果证据极为匮乏。现有政策制定缺乏实证基础，需要严谨的随机对照试验来评估其有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于教育政策干预理论、行为合规理论以及技术采用与教育生产力理论，考察指导（能力建设路径）与执行（威慑路径）两种机制对学生AI使用行为和学业成果的交互效应。
AI.method: 在中国两所中学开展随机对照试验（N=1,056），交叉随机分配两个干预因素：(1)六模块AI素养课程（指导条件）；(2)强制执行干预——对写作作业设定30%AI内容上限，通过多引擎AI筛查与教师验证检测违规，标记后强制重交。分析学业表现（写作成绩）与合规行为（违规率）的因果效应，并考察性别异质性。
AI.findings: (1)单独提供AI素养指导或单独执行AI内容上限均无可检测的学业提升；(2)指导与执行相结合显著提高写作成绩，尤其改善中文写作；(3)写作提升集中在男生群体；(4)合规行为存在性别差异：仅指导条件下女生减少AI违规，而男生违规率仍高于其他条件；(5)没有配套执行机制的指导可能适得其反。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究首次通过大规模随机对照试验提供了AI教育政策的因果证据，揭示了指导与执行的互补性而非替代性作用机制；同时识别出政策效应的性别异质性，丰富了教育技术政策的行为理论——不同性别学生对软性指导与硬性约束的反应模式存在系统性差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学校和政策制定者提供基于实证的AI教育管理建议：仅靠教学指导不足以有效规范学生使用AI，必须配合设计良好的合规执行机制；同时提示政策设计需考虑性别差异，避免一刀切策略在男生群体上的失效或适得其反效应。

title:
Resources Change Hands, Capability Does Not 
A Low-Capability Equilibrium and Eighty Years of British Reform
affiliations: Strategic Policy Research, Inc.

detail.title:
Resources Change Hands, Capability Does Not 
A Low-Capability Equilibrium and Eighty Years of British Reform
detail.abstract:
Since 1945 Britain has alternated repeatedly between two opposed policy paradigmspostwar state ownership and Thatcherite market liberalism-and yet every reform wave has reproduced the same territorial imbalance: a hyper-capable centre and a hollowed periphery. This paper asks why. It argues that the recurrence is not a sequence of policy mistakes but a stable, self-reinforcing equilibrium, and that its persistence follows from a single, generalisable proposition: states can change who allocates resources far more easily than they can change where capability is generated.
The asymmetry has a mechanism: capability is generated only through institutional learning under responsibility that cannot be shifted elsewhere, whereas ownership can be altered by legislation, so the two move at entirely different speeds. Reform in Britain has repeatedly changed the resource-allocation paradigm — who owns and directs the economy — while leaving untouched the capability-generation mechanism, which has remained monopolised at the centre throughout. Drawing a distinction between central and distributed state capability, and extending Michael Mann’s concept of infrastructural power one step further to locally generated capability, the paper supplies a behavioural microfoundation (capability accrues through institutional learning under responsibility that cannot be shifted elsewhere), models the recurrence as a low distributed-capability equilibrium, and states the conditions under which the theory would be falsified. It then tests the mechanism against eighty years of British experience — five “doses,” one equilibrium — using Germany as a comparative counter-curve, and shows how successive governing coalitions, though they change, each inherit and reinforce the same central machine. The paper closes by arguing that the fiscal crisis of the 2020s is, for the first time in eighty years, an exogenous shock of the kind that could make fiscal devolution rational for the centre itself rather than merely desirable to the periphery — a prediction, and offered as such — and by drawing out what the proposition predicts for other centralised states. Britain is treated throughout not as an object of national-declinist commentary but as the clearest, best-documented instance of a general law.

AI.tldr: 本文解释了英国自1945年以来反复在国家所有制与撒切尔式市场自由主义之间摇摆，却始终维持"强中心—空心边缘"领土失衡的原因。作者提出一个普适命题：国家改变资源配置者（所有权）远比改变能力生成地点容易得多。能力只能通过不可转移的责任下的制度学习产生，而所有权可通过立法改变，两者速度差异导致英国历次改革都只改变了资源分配范式，却从未触动集中于中央的能力生成机制。文章以迈克尔·曼的基础性权力概念为起点，延伸出"分布式国家能力"概念，提供行为微观基础，将这种反复建模为低分布式能力均衡，用80年英国经验（五次"剂量"、一个均衡）与德国对比检验，并预言2020年代财政危机可能首次使财政分权对中央自身变得理性。
AI.research_question: 为什么英国自1945年以来反复在两个对立政策范式（战后国有化与撒切尔式市场自由主义）之间交替，却每次改革浪潮都再生产出同样的领土失衡——高度能干的中央与空心化的边缘？
AI.motivation: 现有解释将英国的地域失衡视为一系列政策失误，但本文认为这种反复不是偶然的政策错误序列，而是一个稳定、自我强化的均衡。作者旨在揭示这一反复背后的普适规律，并摆脱"英国衰败论"的民族性叙事，将英国视为一般规律最清晰、记录最完备的实例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文延伸迈克尔·曼的"基础性权力"（infrastructural power）概念，提出"分布式国家能力"（distributed state capability）与"中央国家能力"的区分；核心命题是"国家改变资源配置者远比改变能力生成地点容易"；提供行为微观基础——能力通过不可转移的责任下的制度学习而累积。
AI.method: 理论建模与历史案例比较：提出低分布式能力均衡模型并明确理论被证伪的条件；以80年英国经验为检验对象，识别五次改革"剂量"但同一均衡；使用德国作为比较性反曲线（counter-curve）进行对照检验。
AI.findings: 英国历次改革（无论左翼还是右翼政府）都只改变了资源分配范式（谁拥有和指导经济），而未触碰能力生成机制，该机制始终被中央垄断。能力的生成只能通过不可移转的责任下的制度学习，而所有权可由立法改变，二者速度根本不同，由此形成低分布式能力均衡。各届执政联盟虽不断更替，但都继承并强化了同一台中央机器。德国作为反例提供了比较支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统区分中央国家能力与分布式国家能力；将曼的基础性权力概念从"国家渗透社会"推进到"地方生成能力"；提出"能力只能通过不可转移责任下的制度学习生成"这一行为微观基础；将国家结构失衡建模为低分布式能力均衡，并明确可证伪条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 预言2020年代的财政危机是80年来第一次可能使财政分权对中央自身而言变得理性（而非仅对外围地区可取）的外生冲击；为该命题对其他集权国家的预测提供分析框架，为政策制定者理解改革为何反复失败提供理论诊断。

title: Western Electronics Inside Sanctioned Russian Weapons: The Hong Kong Route That Won't Close

detail.title: Western Electronics Inside Sanctioned Russian Weapons: The Hong Kong Route That Won't Close
detail.abstract: This brief investigates how Western-made microelectronics continue reaching Russian precision-guided missile and drone programs more than four years into sanctions on their export. Drawing on U.S. Treasury, Commerce, and Justice Department enforcement actions, European Union sanctions designations, and independently corroborated investigative research, it maps a durable Hong Kong-centered trading network responsible for documented shipments of Tier 1 controlled components to sanctioned Russian entities. The analysis identifies the structural mechanism enabling this persistence: a distributor visibility gap in which compliance obligations end one sale before a component's actual destination is determined. Six enforcement actions across four jurisdictions since 2024 are examined in sequence, alongside named on-record analysis from sanctions researchers describing the same failure from the manufacturer's side. The brief argues that closing this gap requires extending verification obligations one tier further down the distribution chain rather than tightening controls at the point of first sale, which current evidence shows is already functioning as intended.

AI.tldr: 本文调查了在对俄微型电子产品出口实施制裁四年多之后，西方制造的微电子器件如何仍持续流入俄罗斯精确制导导弹和无人机项目。通过分析美国财政部、商务部、司法部的执法行动、欧盟制裁指定以及独立调查研究的佐证，揭示了以香港为中心的、持续向受制裁俄罗斯实体运送一级受控组件的贸易网络，并识别出其持续存在的结构性机制——分销商可见性缺口。
AI.research_question: 为什么在实施制裁四年多之后，西方制造的微电子器件仍能持续到达俄罗斯精确制导导弹和无人机项目？其持久性背后的结构性机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 制裁出口四年多后，西方微电子器件仍持续流入俄罗斯军事项目，说明现有制裁执行机制存在系统性失效，亟需识别其结构性缺陷并提出有效的政策改进方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分销商可见性缺口理论：合规义务在组件实际目的地确定之前就终止于第一次销售环节，使制造商在下游分销链中无法追踪或验证组件的最终去向。
AI.method: 基于美国财政部、商务部、司法部执法行动记录、欧盟制裁指定名单、独立调查研究的联合证据，分析自2024年以来四个司法管辖区的六起执法行动，并结合制裁研究人员的有记录访谈分析。
AI.findings: 发现了一个以香港为中心的持久性贸易网络，负责向受制裁的俄罗斯实体运送一级受控组件。结构性机制是分销商可见性缺口——合规义务在第一次销售即告终止，早于组件实际目的地被确定的时间点。执法证据显示，在首次销售点收紧管制已按预期发挥作用，但无法阻止组件经多次转手后最终到达俄罗斯。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"分销商可见性缺口"概念，将制裁规避问题从首次销售合规层面重新概念化为分销链末端追踪失败的制度性缺陷，为理解制裁执行的结构性盲区提供了新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体政策建议：将验证义务沿着分销链向下延伸一层（而非在首次销售点收紧控制），以弥合合规缺口，阻断受控组件流向受制裁实体的通道。

title: Riding Behaviour of Commercial Delivery Motorcyclists Measured with Smartphone and Sensor-Tag Telematics: Event Rates and a Combined Rider Behaviour Model
affiliations: Stellenbosch University, Stellenbosch University, World Bank Group and Stellenbosch University - Faculty of Engineering

detail.title: Riding Behaviour of Commercial Delivery Motorcyclists Measured with Smartphone and Sensor-Tag Telematics: Event Rates and a Combined Rider Behaviour Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a secondary analysis of telematics data collected by the SSATP/World Bank pilot and captured by a commercial insurance provider (Discovery Insure, South Africa) and made available to the authors under a data-sharing agreement with the SSATP program (through the World Bank) and Discovery Insurance. Written informed consent for data collection and research use was obtained from all riders by the SSATP pilot at the point of original data collection. Author two was present during data collection to oversee compliance and holds the signed consent documentation on this basis; he did not take part in the data analysis. The data used for analysis was fully anonymised, and the analysing authors had no access to identifying information and no direct contact with participants.
declarations.funderStatement: World Bank Group.

detail.abstract: Naturalistic driving studies rely on thresholds that separate an ordinary manoeuvre from a hard one, yet for powered two-wheelers this boundary is unresolved: published triggers vary by an order of magnitude and none are derived from the vehicle or population studied. We address this gap with a rider behaviour model that detects, verifies, and grades five naturalistic riding behaviours, acceleration, braking, cornering, speeding, and stop compliance, using smartphone and vehicle-tag telematics from a fleet of 28 commercial delivery motorcyclists in Stellenbosch, South Africa. Each behaviour is scored by a detector that selects the signal and metric suited to it, isolates events, verifies each against a second signal or internal consistency, grades severity on a scale frozen from the fleet's own range, and aggregates events into an unweighted score out of 100. Applying this model to 1,382 acceleration and braking events over 17,196 qualitygated kilometres, 1,153 pass verification; 23 of 28 riders are scored on this behaviour and 19 on stop compliance. Acceleration and braking scores correlate only weakly across riders (0.29), so harshness in one does not predict harshness in the other; three tracked riders show a comparable crossover across all five behaviours, with no rider uniformly best or worst. The frozen braking and acceleration scales land within published motorcyclist deceleration and naturalistic-use ranges, validating thresholds set without prior literature; percentile-sweep and split-window checks show rankings are stable and recur over time for the better-populated behaviours. This evidenceanchored approach offers a transferable methodology for naturalistic powered-two-wheeler risk scoring.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于智能手机和车辆标签遥测数据的骑手行为模型，用于检测、验证和评分摩托车骑手的五种自然骑行行为（加速、制动、转弯、超速和停车合规）。该方法从28名南非商业送货摩托车骑手的车队数据中提取阈值，并通过多种验证手段确保评分的稳定性和有效性。研究发现加速和制动评分之间相关性较弱，且不同骑手在不同行为中的表现存在交叉，没有骑手在所有行为中表现一致最优或最差。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一种基于研究车辆和人群自身数据衍生的自然骑行行为检测与评分方法，从而解决动力两轮车"激烈操作"阈值未定且缺乏经验验证的问题？
AI.motivation: 自然驾驶研究中区分常规操作与激烈操作的阈值对动力两轮车而言尚未明确：现有文献中的触发阈值相差一个数量级，且没有一个阈值是从所研究的车辆或人群中推导出来的。这一空白限制了自然驾驶研究在摩托车骑行风险评估中的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究采用数据驱动、证据锚定的方法框架，不依赖先验文献阈值，而是基于车队自身的指标范围来"冻结"严重程度评分尺度，并通过交叉信号验证和内部一致性检查来确保事件检测的可靠性。
AI.method: 研究使用来自南非Stellenbosch地区28名商业送货摩托车骑手的智能手机和车辆标签遥测数据。每种行为由专门的检测器评分：选择适合的信号和指标、隔离事件、通过第二个信号或内部一致性进行验证、基于车队自身范围冻结严重程度等级，并将事件聚合成0-100分的未加权得分。研究还采用了百分位扫描和分裂窗口检查来验证排名的稳定性和可重复性。
AI.findings: 在17,196公里的质量门控数据中检测到1,382个加速和制动事件，其中1,153个通过验证；28名骑手中23名在该行为上获得评分，19名获得停车合规评分。加速与制动评分的跨骑手相关性较弱（0.29），表明一个维度的激烈程度不能预测另一个维度。3名被跟踪的骑手在全部五种行为上表现出可比的交叉现象，没有骑手在所有行为中表现一致最优或最差。冻结的制动和加速评分尺度落在已发表的摩托车减速和自然使用范围内，验证了在没有先验文献情况下设定的阈值。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究提出了一种可迁移的自然动力两轮车风险评分方法论，该方法不依赖先验文献阈值，而是从所研究的车队数据中推导并验证阈值，填补了动力两轮车自然驾驶研究中阈值缺乏经验验证的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究为摩托车车队（尤其是商业送货摩托车队）提供了一套实用的骑行行为风险评估工具，能够通过智能手机和遥测设备识别激烈驾驶行为，为车队安全管理和骑手培训提供数据支撑。同时，研究证明了不同骑行行为维度之间相对独立，提示安全干预需要针对特定行为而非泛化的"激烈驾驶"概念。

title: Analysis of Influencing Factors of Farmland Pollination Services: Cross-Level Moderating Effects of Farmers and Villages
affiliations: Inner Mongolia Normal University, Inner Mongolia Normal University and Inner Mongolia Normal University

detail.title: Analysis of Influencing Factors of Farmland Pollination Services: Cross-Level Moderating Effects of Farmers and Villages
detail.abstract: Pollination services, as a core ecosystem service bridging natural ecology and agricultural production, play an irreplaceable role in safeguarding food security and driving green agricultural transformation. However, in village-level agricultural landscapes dominated by smallholder dispersed farming, the farmlands managed by individual households and the semi-natural habitats within village boundaries collectively form a mosaic landscape pattern. This causes the supply and maintenance of farmland pollination services to be simultaneously influenced by factors at both the household and village levels, exhibiting a typical double-layer nested characteristic. Yet research specifically addressing this feature remains scarce. Based on field surveys and household questionnaire data from 480 households across 22 villages in Dengkou County, Inner Mongolia, this study calculated a household-level pollination service index and a village-level semi-natural habitat pollination potential index, collected additional factors at both levels, and employed Hierarchical Linear Modeling (HLM) to disentangle the independent effects of the household and village levels while testing cross-level interaction effects on pollination services. The results show that village-level variation accounts for 6.9% of the total variance in pollination services, confirming the necessity of the nested structure. Household behaviors such as retaining wildflowers and keeping bees independently significantly enhance pollination services. The village-level semi-natural habitat pollination potential index, crop diversity, and the proportion of cooperative beekeeping all show significant positive effects. More importantly, cross-level interaction analysis reveals two distinct moderating mechanisms—substitution effects and synergy effects—indicating that the same household behavior produces differentiated ecological outcomes across villages with different landscape contexts. Our findings underscore the need to incorporate household environmentally friendly behaviors into ecological subsidy programs, and to leverage land consolidation and ecological restoration policies to promote semi-natural habitat construction through village-specific classification based on resource endowment differences, thereby enhancing pollination services. This study provides empirical evidence for the precise design of agro-ecological conservation policies under smallholder farming systems and offers reference for other developing countries exploring synergies between ecology and agriculture.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于内蒙古磴口县22个村庄480户农户的调查数据，运用多层线性模型（HLM）分析了农户和村庄两个层级对农田授粉服务的嵌套影响，发现村庄层级解释了6.9%的方差变异，农户层面保留野花和养蜂行为显著提升授粉服务，且存在替代与协同两种跨层交互调节机制，为小农经营下的农业生态保护政策设计提供了实证依据。
AI.research_question: 在农户分散经营的小农农业景观中，农户和村庄两个层级如何共同影响农田授粉服务的供给与维持？跨层级交互效应如何发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 授粉服务对粮食安全和绿色农业转型至关重要，但现有研究忽视了小农经营下农户与村庄双层嵌套结构对授粉服务的影响，缺乏针对该特征的专门研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态系统服务理论、多层嵌套结构理论（HLM框架）、景观生态学中的斑块-廊道-基质理论
AI.method: 基于内蒙古磴口县22个村庄480户农户的实地调查与问卷调查数据，构建农户层级授粉服务指数和村庄层级半自然生境授粉潜力指数，运用多层线性模型（HLM）分离农户与村庄层级的独立效应并检验跨层级交互效应。
AI.findings: （1）村庄层级变异占授粉服务总变异的6.9%，证实嵌套结构的必要性；（2）农户保留野花和养蜂行为显著提升授粉服务；（3）村庄层级半自然生境授粉潜力指数、作物多样性和合作养蜂比例均呈显著正效应；（4）跨层级交互分析揭示替代效应和协同效应两种调节机制，不同村庄景观情境下相同农户行为产生差异化生态结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将多层线性模型应用于小农农业景观中授粉服务的双层嵌套结构分析，揭示了农户与村庄层级间的替代与协同交互机制，拓展了生态系统服务供给的层级分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为将农户环保行为纳入生态补贴计划提供了实证依据；建议结合土地整治和生态修复政策，根据资源禀赋差异对村庄进行分类施策，推动半自然生境建设，为其他发展中国家生态与农业协同发展提供参考。

title: Goals of the Afcfta Competition Protocol Digital Marketcompetition Regulations: Lessons from South Africa's Online Intermediation Platform Market Inquiry (OIPMI), The Eu's Dma and the Us Experiences with Digital Platform Giants
affiliations: Technische Universität München (TUM) and

detail.title: Goals of the Afcfta Competition Protocol Digital Marketcompetition Regulations: Lessons from South Africa's Online Intermediation Platform Market Inquiry (OIPMI), The Eu's Dma and the Us Experiences with Digital Platform Giants
detail.abstract: The European Union (EU) has continued to be a worldwide leader in setting international norms, particularly in competition law policy, data protection and platform governance. In digital market regulation, after the EU Digital Markets Act (DMA), several countries have adopted or are considering the adoption of digital markets competition regulations (DMCR) similar to the DMA. While some have challenged the notion that the DMA and its goals of ensuring contestability and fairness in the market should not be the blueprint for adopting DMCRs in other countries, at this juncture, it is impossible to overstate the influence of the EU DMA on future DMCRs. We contribute towards this scholarly debate on the influence of the DMA beyond the EU by focusing on a region that, despite competition agencies’ regulatory enforcement in digital markets, has not received adequate scholarly attention: Africa. Although no African country has considered adopting a DMCR at the continental level, African countries seek to adopt a DMCR under the AfCFTA Competition Protocol (CP). In formulating the appropriate goals of the AfCFTA DMCR, we build on African experiences in enforcing competition law, the African market structure, the debate on the goals of competition law in Africa, intellectual thinking on regulation of digital markets and the EU DMA. More specifically, for the African context, we draw on the 2023 Competition Commission of South Africa, Online Intermediation Platforms Market Inquiry (OIPMI) findings on business user treatment to further inform the appropriate goals of the AfCFTA DMCR. An analysis of the OIPMI Final Report shows that African markets have high barriers to entry, and digital platforms impose unfair trading conditions on African businesses compared to international businesses. Consequently, like the EU DMA, fairness and contestability are critical for the success of African businesses in the digital markets. Given that public interest considerations will continue to shape African competition law enforcement in digital markets, African countries can draw from the insights of the EU Ordoliberal thinking as related to the currently dissipated US New Brandeisian movement, both of which seek to enhance the participation of small businesses in a market characterized by few firms with concentrated economic power. We conclude by recommending that, unlike the DMA, in which the goals are distinct from competition law, the AfCFTA DMCR should incorporate multiple goals merging regulatory goals with those of competition law enforcement, while prioritizing innovation, inclusivity, fairness, and contestability.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨欧盟《数字市场法》（DMA）对非洲数字市场竞争监管（DMCR）的影响，特别是非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）竞争协议下DMCR的目标设定。基于南非OIPMI调查发现，非洲市场存在高进入壁垒和平台对非洲企业的不公平交易条件，因此公平性和可竞争性对非洲企业至关重要。文章建议AfCFTA DMCR应不同于DMA，将监管目标与竞争法执行目标合并，优先考虑创新、包容性、公平性和可竞争性。
AI.research_question: 在制定非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）竞争协议下的数字市场竞争监管（DMCR）时，应以何种目标为导向？欧盟DMA及其公平性和可竞争性目标是否（以及如何）适用于非洲背景？
AI.motivation: 尽管多个国家已采纳或考虑采纳类似DMA的数字市场法规，但非洲地区在学术上未受到充分关注。虽然非洲竞争监管机构已在数字市场执行竞争法，但没有非洲国家在大陆层面考虑采纳DMCR，而AfCFTA竞争协议正寻求建立这一制度。本文旨在填补这一学术空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟DMA的公平性和可竞争性目标框架；欧盟Ordoliberal思想；美国新布兰代斯运动（New Brandeisian movement）；非洲竞争法目标辩论；公共利益考量在非洲竞争法执行中的作用。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析：基于非洲竞争法执行经验、非洲市场结构、竞争法目标辩论、数字市场监管的学术思考以及欧盟DMA的综合分析；重点分析2023年南非竞争委员会在线中介平台市场调查（OIPMI）最终报告的发现。
AI.findings: 非洲市场具有高进入壁垒，数字平台对非洲企业施加不公平交易条件（相比国际企业）。公平性和可竞争性对非洲企业在数字市场的成功至关重要。欧盟Ordoliberal思想和新布兰代斯运动都有助于增强小企业在集中经济权力市场中的参与。与DMA不同，AfCFTA DMCR应合并监管目标与竞争法执行目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 将欧盟DMA及其理论（Ordoliberal思想）扩展到非洲大陆语境，为AfCFTA DMCR目标设定提供理论框架，丰富了关于DMA在欧盟以外影响力的学术辩论，填补了非洲数字市场监管研究的学术空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲政策制定者在制定AfCFTA竞争协议下的DMCR提供具体建议：目标应多元化，涵盖监管与竞争法执行的融合，优先考虑创新、包容性、公平性和可竞争性，而非简单复制DMA模式。

title: The Law of the Algorithmic State in Central and Eastern Europe
affiliations: University of Trieste and University of Trieste School of Law

detail.title: The Law of the Algorithmic State in Central and Eastern Europe
detail.abstract: The paper is an introduction to a special issue of the Italian Journal of Public Law on the law of the algorithmic state in Central and Eastern Europe. It explains why the issue focuses on the state as developer and user of emerging technologies, and on Central and Eastern European countries as the relevant units of comparison. The paper gives some further insights about the methodology adopted in making the issue and about the main comparative lessons learned from this collective endeavour.

AI.tldr: 本文是《意大利公法杂志》特刊的导言，聚焦中欧和东欧算法国家的法律问题，解释了为何以国家作为新兴技术的开发者和使用者为研究重点，以及为何选择中东欧国家作为比较对象，并介绍了特刊的研究方法和主要比较教训。
AI.research_question: 中欧和东欧国家在作为新兴技术的开发者和使用者时，其算法国家的法律框架呈现怎样的特征和差异？
AI.motivation: 算法国家（algorithmic state）正在全球范围内兴起，但学界对中欧和东欧这一特定区域的研究不足；该区域国家的法律传统、转型历程和数字治理路径具有独特性，值得专门比较研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 特刊基于比较公法和算法治理的理论视角，将国家视为新兴技术的开发者与使用者，通过区域比较方法考察中东欧国家的法律实践。具体理论框架需结合特刊各篇论文进一步展开。
AI.method: 比较法研究方法，以中东欧国家为比较单元，采用集体合作的编辑方式，汇聚多国学者对不同国家算法国家法律实践的比较分析。
AI.findings: 摘要未提供具体研究发现，但指出特刊总结了一些主要的比较教训（main comparative lessons），具体内容需查阅特刊正文。
AI.theory_contributions: 将算法国家的讨论从西方主流国家扩展到中欧和东欧区域，丰富了比较公法在数字治理领域的理论视角，为理解不同法律传统下的算法治理提供了新的比较框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和法律实务工作者提供了中东欧国家算法治理的横向比较经验，有助于识别该区域算法国家法律发展的共性与差异，为立法和监管实践提供参考。

title: The Most Important Human Skills for the Age of AI and the Future of Work: FILE — The Five Intelligences of Leadership Evolution

detail.title: The Most Important Human Skills for the Age of AI and the Future of Work: FILE — The Five Intelligences of Leadership Evolution

keywords: Leadership in The Age of AI

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence changes what organizations can do; human leadership must decide what should be done, what remains accountable, and what must never be surrendered to machines. This working paper presents FILE — the Five Intelligences of Leadership Evolution — as a human-centered management theory and diagnostic framework for responsible leadership and decision-making in the age of AI. FILE argues that the most important human skills for the AI era and the future of work require the integrated exercise of five meta-intelligences: Augmented Intelligence, Emotional Intelligence, Cultural Intelligence, Political Intelligence, and Adaptive Intelligence. The paper defines the FILE formula, maps the framework onto the human hand, presents the 70 nested intelligences of FILE, explains five emergent outcomes, and develops RC — The Relational Commons as the shared human ecosystem that leadership must protect, cultivate, and renew. It also clarifies boundaries among adjacent intelligences, offers a diagnostic application to AI-supported employee performance evaluation, and states limitations and future research directions. Its purpose is to establish a public, citable, and timestamped record of FILE as a management theory of human leadership in the age of AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FILE（领导力进化五智）框架，作为AI时代以人为本的管理理论与诊断工具，主张人类领导者需整合运用增强智能、情绪智能、文化智能、政治智能和适应智能五种元智能，并保护"关系公域"。
AI.research_question: 在人工智能时代，什么样的人类领导技能最为关键？领导者应如何负责任地进行决策并守护不应让渡给机器的人类职能？
AI.motivation: 人工智能正在改变组织的能力边界，但哪些决策、责任和职能绝不能让渡给机器，人类领导者必须明确；现有理论缺乏一个系统性的、以人为本的框架来指导AI时代的负责任领导与决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: FILE——领导力进化五智框架，涵盖五种元智能：增强智能（Augmented Intelligence）、情绪智能（Emotional Intelligence）、文化智能（Cultural Intelligence）、政治智能（Political Intelligence）和适应智能（Adaptive Intelligence）；以及关系公域（Relational Commons, RC）概念。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念框架开发：定义FILE公式，将框架映射到人类手掌模型，呈现70种嵌套智能，阐明五种涌现结果，界定相邻智能之间的边界，并应用于AI辅助的员工绩效评估场景进行诊断示范。
AI.findings: FILE框架可作为AI时代人类领导力的管理理论；五种元智能的综合运用构成最重要的AI时代人类技能；关系公域是领导者必须保护、培育和更新的共享人类生态系统；框架可用于AI辅助员工绩效评估等实际管理场景。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了"AI时代人类领导力"的公开、可引用、带时间戳的原创管理理论（FILE），填补了AI时代以人为本领导理论框架的空白，并提出了"关系公域"这一新的理论概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织和管理者提供了一个可操作的诊断框架，界定了哪些人类智能必须保留而非让渡给AI，并示范了其在AI辅助员工绩效评估中的实际应用。

reference: Camilla Crea and Marta Infantino (eds.), Remedies to Digital Vulnerability in European Private Law. Pathways towards Fairness, Springer, 2025, 335-360
title: Digital Vulnerability for All?
affiliations: University of Trieste and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Digital Vulnerability for All?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Camilla Crea and Marta Infantino (eds.), Remedies to Digital Vulnerability in European Private Law. Pathways towards Fairness, Springer, 2025, 335-360

detail.abstract: What if we took seriously the idea recently put forward by many institutions and scholars that, in online interactions, all human beings are vulnerable or made more vulnerable than ordinary? What if our regulatory infrastructures acknowledged that the vast majority of us, even in the hyperconnected societies of the Global North, have little understanding of the digital infrastructure on which we depend? This chapter aims to explore these questions and propose a new interpretive framework, using European private law as a testing ground at the crossroads of national and European Union rules. In particular, it investigates whether assuming that we are all vulnerable might reduce the protection for those who belong to protected categories and are at heightened risk of cumulative and intersectional discrimination. It tests whether embracing digital vulnerability as a universal condition would lead to an unacceptable level of personalization of the law and burden corporations and individuals with excessive vulnerability-related duties. The chapter also verifies whether and how vulnerability-related duties might be enforceable in the borderless digital environment. All of the above will hopefully help challenge current interpretive views that deny any relevance to online defenselessness.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在数字环境中将"全民皆脆弱"理念纳入法律监管框架的可行性，以欧洲私法为试验场，分析了这一普遍脆弱性假设对特定受保护群体、法律个性化程度、企业义务负担以及跨境执法可能性的影响，旨在挑战当前否认网络环境中公民脆弱性的主流解释观点。
AI.research_question: 如果我们在法律和监管框架中认真对待"所有人都可能在网上变得脆弱"这一理念，会产生什么后果？具体而言：(1) 普遍脆弱性假设是否会削弱对特定受保护群体的保护？(2) 是否会带来不可接受的法律个性化程度？(3) 脆弱性相关义务是否会过度加重企业和个人的负担？(4) 在无国界的数字环境中，这些义务是否可执行？
AI.motivation: 许多机构和学者最近提出，在在线互动中所有人都可能变得脆弱或比以往更脆弱，但现有监管框架仍否认网络环境中脆弱性的相关性。本文旨在认真对待这一假设，探索将其纳入监管基础设施的可能后果，并挑战当前否认在线无助状态重要性的解释观点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字脆弱性理论（digital vulnerability）和欧洲私法框架（European private law），在国家和欧盟规则的交叉路口上，运用交叉性与累积性歧视理论作为分析工具。
AI.method: 概念分析与规范性法律论证方法，以欧洲私法为试验场，通过情境推演检验普遍脆弱性假设在四个维度上的后果：对特定群体的保护影响、法律个性化程度、义务负担以及跨境可执行性。
AI.findings: 研究发现：将数字脆弱性视为普遍条件可能对特定受保护群体的保护产生潜在削弱风险；可能引致不可接受的过度法律个性化；会给企业和个人带来过重的脆弱性相关义务；且在无边界的数字环境中，这些义务的可执行性存在重大疑问。这些分析共同挑战了当前否认网络脆弱性相关性的主导解释框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个全新的解释性框架（interpretive framework），将"普遍数字脆弱性"作为一个严肃的法律分析起点，系统性地评估了其在法律保护、义务分配和跨境实施等方面的理论含义，填补了在数字环境中脆弱性法律理论方面的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及成员国立法者提供了关于如何将数字脆弱性纳入监管设计的警示性指导，帮助识别和避免普遍脆弱性假设可能带来的监管陷阱，同时对数字时代消费者保护法的制定具有实践参考价值。

title: Contract Design and Bus Electrification: Evidence from Santiago, Chile
affiliations: Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile

detail.title: Contract Design and Bus Electrification: Evidence from Santiago, Chile
detail.abstract: Santiago went from about 100 electric buses in 2018 to nearly 4,400 by early 2026, the largest electric-bus fleet outside China. This paper analyzes the contract design behind the transition. Successive tenders unbundled service operation from fleet ownership and charging infrastructure. They turned buses and terminals into concession-dedicated assets that transfer to the next operator. They also paid fleet financing through fixed monthly installments, administered centrally and owed regardless of which operator runs the route. This design removed the two risks that make lenders charge a premium on transit assets: stranding at contract end and operator default. It made electric capital financeable without operators bearing it. A permanent subsidy, created in 2009, made the long payment horizons credible. Competition widened accordingly: participation rose from 16 offers in 2019 to 84 in 2023, and the monthly fleet installment per electric bus fell by 10 to 25 percent. Using payment and tender records, I show that electrification did not materially change the cost per kilometer of service and did not require a new funding source. The 2019 bids priced both technologies under the same contracts. They imply that renewing the fleet with new diesel buses would not have been cheaper per kilometer. I conclude with policy lessons and the conditions under which the model transfers to other cities.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了智利圣地亚哥从2018年约100辆电动公交车增长到2026年初近4400辆（中国以外最大电动公交车队）的转型过程，重点研究其合同设计。通过将服务运营与车队所有权和充电基础设施分离、将公交车和终点站转为可转移的特许经营专属资产、以及通过中央管理的固定月付款支付车队融资，该设计消除了贷款人对公交资产溢价的两大风险：合同结束时的搁浅风险和运营商违约风险。这使得电动资本无需运营商承担即可获得融资，2009年建立的永久补贴使长期支付期限可信。竞争随之扩大（参与报价从2019年16份增至2023年84份），每辆电动公交车的月车队分期付款下降10%至25%。使用付款和招标记录，作者证明电气化并未实质性改变每公里服务成本，也无需新的资金来源。
AI.research_question: 圣地亚哥如何通过合同设计实现大规模公交车队电气化转型？具体而言，合同设计如何影响电动公交车的融资可行性、竞争程度以及每公里服务成本？
AI.motivation: 公共交通电气化是减少碳排放的关键路径，但电动公交车的资本成本远高于柴油车，融资困难是主要障碍。贷款人对公交资产收取溢价的原因在于合同结束时的资产搁浅风险和运营商违约风险。理解圣地亚哥这一全球领先的案例（中国以外最大电动公交车队），可以为其他城市提供可借鉴的政策经验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文的理论框架围绕合同设计与资产融资风险展开，涉及：（1）资产搁浅（stranding）风险与特许经营合同设计的关系；（2）运营商违约风险与融资结构的关系；（3）资产专用性与可转移性对融资能力的影响；（4）政府补贴的承诺可信度与长期投资的关系。
AI.method: 本文使用付款记录和招标记录进行实证分析。具体包括：对比电动公交车与柴油公交车在同一合同框架下的报价差异；分析历次招标的参与度和报价趋势；估算每公里服务成本的变化。
AI.findings: （1）合同设计消除了资产搁浅和运营商违约两大风险，使电动资本无需运营商承担即可获得融资；（2）竞争显著扩大：参与报价从2019年16份增至2023年84份；（3）每辆电动公交车的月车队分期付款下降10%至25%；（4）电气化并未实质性改变每公里服务成本；（5）2019年投标数据表明，更换新柴油公交车在每公里成本上并不会比电动公交车更便宜；（6）电气化无需新的资金来源。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）揭示了合同设计如何作为解决资本密集型基础设施融资障碍的制度机制；（2）将资产可转移性（concession-dedicated asset transfer）概念与融资可行性联系起来，为公共交通电气化的融资理论提供了新的分析框架；（3）说明了补贴承诺可信度（credible commitment）在长期资本投资中的关键作用；（4）为"资本成本高低不必然决定技术选择"提供了实证证据——合同结构而非技术本身决定了每公里成本。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为其他城市提供了可复制的公共交通电气化合同设计蓝图；（2）展示了如何在无需新资金来源的情况下实现大规模电气化转型；（3）提供了降低融资成本的具体机制（中央管理固定月付款、资产转移条款、永久补贴）；（4）总结政策经验并阐明该模式向其他城市转移的条件。

title: Unreasonable Assurance: The Auditing Industry Meets the DSA's Systemic Risk Regime
affiliations: University of Amsterdam - Institute for Information Law (IViR), University of Amsterdam - Institute for Information Law (IViR) and University of Amsterdam

detail.title: Unreasonable Assurance: The Auditing Industry Meets the DSA's Systemic Risk Regime

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This publication has been supported via the NWO Grant A Law-compliant Trustworthy Blockchain Economy (BLOCK.2019.004), as well as the UvA Trust in the digital society Research Priority Area, and the UvA Faculty Research Strategic Investment Fund for Trust in Digital Markets: Keeping Tabs on Systemic Risks.

detail.abstract: The Digital Services Act introduces a regulatory obligation requiring very large online platforms and search engines to identify and mitigate systemic risks linked to their services, which, under Article 37, must undergo independent audits on a yearly basis. This emerging "audit ecosystem" places auditing firms in an uneasy position: while they are expected to deliver assessments of reasonable assurance, they themselves often frame their role as necessarily limited, procedural, and dependent on client-provided evidence. To address these tensions, this paper adopts an actor-centred perspective on the DSA's audit framework and based on an expert workshop with auditors and DSA researchers, provides insights on how the system is understood and enacted by those implementing it in practice. We present four (epistemic, methodological, professional and structural/political) core issues regarding auditors' role and expectations within the framework. Finally, this paper invites to reflect on the auditor role within the DSA enforcement, raising fundamental questions about who is and should be positioned to take auditing responsibilities in the realm of systemic risks, given its constructive ambiguity as an essentially contested and socially constructed concept, that reflects, rather than challenges existing power relations.

AI.tldr: 本文采用行动者中心视角，基于专家研讨会（auditors与DSA研究人员），分析《数字服务法案》（DSA）第37条所构建的独立审计生态系统中审计师所面临的角色张力与核心问题（认识论、方法论、专业性与结构性/政治性四个维度），并批判性反思审计师在系统性风险治理中的定位与权力关系。
AI.research_question: 在DSA审计框架下，审计师如何理解并实施其角色？审计师在系统性风险评估中面临哪些核心张力与挑战？
AI.motivation: DSA要求超大型在线平台和搜索引擎每年接受独立审计以识别和缓解系统性风险，但审计师自身常将角色定位为有限、程序化且依赖客户提供的证据，这与"合理保证"的监管期待之间构成张力，需要深入理解这一新兴"审计生态系统"的实际运作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行动者中心视角（actor-centred perspective）；"本质上争议的概念"（essentially contested concept）与社会建构理论；权力关系分析
AI.method: 专家研讨会（expert workshop），参与者为审计师和DSA研究人员，基于定性讨论提炼核心议题
AI.findings: 提出四大核心议题：（1）认识论层面——审计师对系统性风险这一模糊概念的理解差异；（2）方法论层面——审计程序与证据基础的局限；（3）专业性层面——审计师能力与角色边界的模糊；（4）结构性/政治性层面——审计师在权力关系中的位置及其对现有权力结构的反映而非挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"本质上争议的概念"与社会建构视角引入监管审计研究，揭示系统性风险作为社会建构概念对审计实践的影响；挑战了审计师作为中立技术执行者的假设，揭示审计角色中的权力维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为DSA监管框架的实施提供实践洞察，提出谁应承担系统性风险审计责任的根本性问题；为政策制定者和监管机构改进审计生态系统的设计提供参考。

title: Pooled, Window, and Sequential Frontiers in Stochastic Frontier Analysis: Matched Parametric Counterparts to Panel DEA in a By-production Framework
affiliations: and University of San Diego

detail.title: Pooled, Window, and Sequential Frontiers in Stochastic Frontier Analysis: Matched Parametric Counterparts to Panel DEA in a By-production Framework

declarations.funderStatement: There are no funding interest to disclose.

detail.abstract: Nonparametric efficiency analysis chooses its benchmark technology through reference-set constructions — contemporaneous, pooled, window, and sequential frontiers — while stochastic frontier analysis (SFA) is silent about which observations define the frontier at each date, so applied DEA–SFA comparisons routinely pair mismatched frontier concepts. We develop the matched parametric counterparts. The sequential construction, which rules out technological regress by expanding the reference set through time, receives a genuinely new counterpart: expanding-sample SFA under a no-regress inequality restriction on technical change, implemented by constrained maximum likelihood and by Bayesian estimation with the restriction in the prior support, including recursive-prior and pointwise-dominance variants. Applied alongside matched DEA to a by-production system (electricity, SO2, NOx) for 92 U.S. coal-fired plants spanning the 1990 Clean Air Act Amendments, three results are central. First, the constraint binds in nine or ten of ten vintages for the only specification detecting SO2 inefficiency — yet never significantly — so the boundary-inference problem afflicting constrained ML is pervasive and the Bayesian implementation earns its keep. Second, the apparent regress dissolves under richer error structures, most decisively under plant random effects, whose plant-conditional predictions dominate every pooled-error specification; the robust verdict is persistent, regulation-correlated heterogeneity rather than technical regress. Third, matched DEA–SFA agreement tracks the strength of the identified inefficiency signal: sequential SO2 rank correlations exceed 0.94, against 0.33 for the pooled intended-output comparison.

AI.tldr: 本文为DEA中常用的参考集构造（同期、合并、窗口、序贯）开发了匹配的参数随机前沿分析（SFA）对应物。序贯构造的新对应物是受"无技术退化"不等式约束的扩展样本SFA，通过约束最大似然和贝叶斯方法实现。应用于92家美国燃煤电厂（1990年清洁空气法修正案）的副产品生产系统分析，发现：（1）约束在检测SO2效率的唯一设定中常被绑定，约束ML的边界推断问题普遍存在，贝叶斯方法更优；（2）表观技术退化在更丰富的误差结构下消失，尤其是电厂随机效应下，真实情况是持续的、与监管相关的异质性而非技术退化；（3）匹配的DEA-SFA一致性取决于效率信号强度：序贯SO2秩相关超0.94，而合并的目标产出比较仅0.33。
AI.research_question: 如何为DEA的各类参考集构造（同期、合并、窗口、序贯前沿）开发匹配的参数SFA对应物，并评估其在燃煤电厂污染物治理效率分析中的表现？
AI.motivation: 非参数效率分析通过参考集构造（同期、合并、窗口、序贯）选择基准技术，而SFA对每个日期哪些观测定义前沿保持沉默，导致应用中的DEA-SFA比较经常配对不匹配的前沿概念，需要开发匹配的参数对应物以进行公平比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非参数效率分析（DEA）的前沿参考集构造理论、随机前沿分析（SFA）、技术退化的序贯约束理论、约束最大似然估计、贝叶斯估计（递归先验和逐点支配变体）
AI.method: 开发匹配DEA各参考集构造的SFA参数对应物；序贯构造对应扩展样本SFA加无退化不等式约束；采用约束最大似然和贝叶斯估计（含递归先验和逐点支配变体）；应用于92家美国燃煤电厂的副产品生产系统（电力、SO2、NOx），覆盖1990年清洁空气法修正案时期。
AI.findings: （1）约束在唯一检测到SO2低效率的设定中于10个年份组中的9-10个被绑定，但从未显著，表明约束ML的边界推断问题普遍存在，贝叶斯实现更有价值；（2）表观技术退化在更丰富的误差结构下消失，尤其是电厂随机效应下，电厂条件预测支配所有合并误差设定，稳健结论是持续的、与监管相关的异质性而非技术退化；（3）匹配DEA-SFA一致性取决于识别的效率信号强度：序贯SO2秩相关超0.94，而合并目标产出比较仅0.33。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地为DEA的各类参考集构造（同期、合并、窗口、序贯）开发匹配的SFA参数对应物；序贯构造获得真正全新的对应物——带无退化不等式约束的扩展样本SFA；揭示了约束ML的边界推断问题在面板数据设定中的普遍性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为DEA-SFA比较提供了匹配的前沿概念框架，避免方法论失配；展示了贝叶斯方法在受约束参数估计中的优越性；对燃煤电厂SO2治理效率提供了更稳健的推断：技术退化表象实为电厂异质性与监管关联效应，为政策评估（清洁空气法修正案）提供了方法论支撑。

title: Smoking Behavior Before and after California's Ban of Menthol Cigarettes
affiliations: , Cornell University, Cornell University - Department of Policy Analysis & Management (PAM), Cornell University and Cornell University

detail.title: Smoking Behavior Before and after California's Ban of Menthol Cigarettes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This study is being conducted with help of a grant to Cornell University from the Global Action to End Smoking (Global Action), a U.S. nonprofit 501(c) (3) private foundation. detail.abstract: California’s statewide menthol cigarette ban creates a central empirical puzzle: while legal sales of menthol cigarettes fall to near zero following the policy, menthol smoking persists. This study investigates the mechanisms underlying this divergence using retail scanner data, population-based surveys, and an original survey of California smokers. Retail data confirm that menthol cigarettes were effectively removed from the legal market, but the decline is accompanied by substitution toward non-menthol cigarettes and menthol-like products. At the same time, population-based surveys indicate no meaningful change in smoking prevalence and continued menthol use. To reconcile these patterns, we use original survey data with within-individual variation to examine behavioral responses directly. We find that 63 percent of menthol smokers continue to report menthol use after the ban, 21 percent switch to non-menthol cigarettes, and few quit. Hazard model estimates show no sustained increase in cessation. The findings indicate that the menthol ban primarily reshapes product composition rather than reducing smoking. Behavioral adjustment occurs mainly through substitution and continued access via existing illicit markets, highlighting the importance of accounting for consumer responses when evaluating product-based tobacco regulations.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用零售扫描数据、人口调查和加州市民烟民原始调查数据，探讨加州全州薄荷醇香烟禁令下"合法销售降至零但薄荷醇吸烟行为持续"这一核心矛盾现象的机制。
AI.research_question: 加州薄荷醇香烟禁令实施后，为何合法销售大幅下降但薄荷醇吸烟行为依然持续？其背后的行为机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 加州全州薄荷醇香烟禁令构成一个核心经验谜题：政策实施后合法销售趋近于零，但薄荷醇吸烟行为并未消退。理解这一分歧背后的机制至关重要，因为产品导向的烟草监管政策能否有效减少吸烟取决于消费者的行为反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者行为替代理论，考察产品禁令下消费者的行为适应机制（替代、持续获取、退出）以及产品构成重塑而非烟草消费总量减少的观点。
AI.method: 结合多种数据来源：零售扫描数据（验证合法市场供给变化）、人口调查（评估吸烟流行率和薄荷醇使用变化）、原创吸烟者调查（利用个体内变异考察行为反应）；采用危险模型（Hazard model）估计戒烟率变化。
AI.findings: 零售数据显示薄荷醇香烟确实从合法市场退出，但伴随向非薄荷醇香烟和薄荷醇类产品的替代；人口调查显示吸烟流行率无实质性变化，薄荷醇使用持续存在；63%的薄荷醇吸烟者在禁令后仍报告使用薄荷醇，21%转向非薄荷醇香烟，极少人戒烟；危险模型显示戒烟率无持续上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了产品导向烟草监管政策在消费者行为适应下的实际效果，指出禁令主要重塑产品构成而非减少吸烟总量，丰富了关于烟草政策有效性与消费者行为反应的讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者和政策制定者提供了重要证据：在评估产品导向烟草监管政策时，必须考虑消费者的替代行为和非法市场获取渠道，为未来类似政策的制定和实施提供了实证依据。

title: A Third Anchor for Global Liquidity: Intellectual Capital Money as a Non-Sovereign Reserve Asset
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Third Anchor for Global Liquidity: Intellectual Capital Money as a Non-Sovereign Reserve Asset
detail.abstract: Global liquidity depends on three interlocking functions: elastic funding, credible reserve assets, and effective official backstops. In the present system, all three rest on the debt of a small number of sovereigns-in practice, largely one. This paper asks whether a productive, non-sovereign class of underlying assets could support reserve-asset creation without reproducing the logic of sovereign-debt expansion. Proposals for supranational reserve assets are not new. What they have consistently left unresolved is a prior question: what should determine the quantity of reserve assets issued? Only two answers have been available-political allocation, as with quota-based allocations of Special Drawing Rights, and the fiscal deficits of a single issuer. I propose a third: the realized volume of transactions in intellectual capital. I develop the institutional design of Intellectual Capital Money (IKM), a claim issued when a transaction in protected intellectual capital is financed, in an amount equal to the negotiated price of that transaction. The obligation constituting IKM is a treaty commitment, binding on all member states, to exchange IKM for member government securities on demand. IKM is therefore non-sovereign debt backed by a diversified pool of sovereign assets. Two implications follow. First, IKM accrues not to the economy in which the rights holder is located but to the economy in which the implementer is located. This implementer-side principle substantially limits the force of the concentration and procyclicality objections. Second, when reserve supply is tied to a productive base rather than to the accumulated liabilities of a single issuer, the sign of the feedback between supply and credibility may reverse. I calibrate this claim: the multiplier exceeds unity but is bounded, and five structural asymmetries make the downward multiplier smaller than the upward one. This is a working paper. Formalization of the sign reversal, the time consistency of the treaty obligation, and quantitative estimates of issuance are left to further work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型储备资产"知识产权货币（IKM）"，其发行量由知识产权交易的实现成交量决定，而非传统的政治配额或单一主权国家财政赤字。IKM是一种非主权债务，由多样化主权资产池担保，通过条约承诺保证其与成员国政府证券的可兑换性。这种设计可能逆转储备供给与可信度之间的反馈方向。
AI.research_question: 生产性的、非主权类别的底层资产能否支撑储备资产的创造，而不复制主权债务扩张的逻辑？具体而言，储备资产的数量应由什么决定？
AI.motivation: 当前全球流动性体系依赖少数主权国家（实际上主要是一个国家）的债务，这在功能上存在集中性和顺周期性风险。超主权储备资产的提案长期存在，但未能解决一个关键前提问题：储备资产的发行量应由什么决定。现有答案只有政治分配（如SDR配额）和单一发行者的财政赤字两种，本文提出第三种方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球流动性三要素理论（弹性融资、可信储备资产、有效官方后盾）；国际储备货币理论；知识产权融资理论；储备供给与可信度的反馈机制理论。
AI.method: 制度设计研究结合理论校准分析。作者设计了IKM的制度架构（知识产权交易融资时发行的债权凭证，金额等于交易协商价格，以条约承诺为义务基础），并通过数学校准论证乘数效应及结构性不对称。
AI.findings: IKM采用"实施者所在地"原则而非"权利持有人所在地"原则分配储备收益，显著限制了集中性和顺周期性异议。当储备供给与生产性基础挂钩而非单一发行者累积负债挂钩时，供给与可信度之间的反馈符号可能逆转。校准结果表明乘数大于1但有界，且五种结构性不对称使下行乘数小于上行乘数。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并论证了储备资产数量的第三种决定机制——知识产权交易成交量；论证了非主权储备资产的可行性；揭示了储备供给与可信度反馈方向可能逆转的理论条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际货币体系改革提供了一种新的制度设计方案——IKM；为缓解全球流动性体系的集中性和顺周期性风险提供了可操作的政策思路；为知识产权融资与全球金融体系的衔接提供了制度蓝图。

title: Measuring the Reliability of Backtest Validation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Measuring the Reliability of Backtest Validation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Before trusting a backtest, practitioners pass it through layers of statistical controls: a robust standard error, a multiple-testing correction, a cross-validation scheme. The working assumption is that each added control makes a validated strategy more trustworthy. We test this assumption by treating the whole validation protocol as a single estimator, whose realized size and power we measure by Monte Carlo simulation with planted ground truth. Protocols are compared only after calibration to the same size. A control improves reliability only when it covers a failure mode left open. Stacking two corrections against the same failure leaves the false-positive rate unchanged and destroys power, and redundancy is decided at the level of the failure sub-mode rather than the family, so two controls from the same family can still be complementary. We measure this across return regimes and resampling schemes, then read a third property that size and power cannot see: how often a protocol validates an edge that has already died. From these measurements we derive a composition rule and a small class of pipelines that satisfies it. At a realistic search scale, honest validation doubles the minimum detectable edge. The benchmark and the code library 1 behind every result are released. The paper proposes no new corrections, only a measurement of how the existing ones combine.

AI.tldr: 本文把整个验证流程视为一个单一估计量，通过蒙特卡洛模拟植入真实信号来测量其实际规模和功效。只有当控制覆盖了尚未被处理的失败模式时，才能提升可靠性；针对同一失败模式叠加两个修正不会改变假阳性率反而会破坏功效。通过跨收益机制和重采样方案测量，作者推导出组合规则和满足该规则的小型流程管线，并发现诚实验证会使最小可检测边际翻倍。
AI.research_question: 叠加更多统计控制（如稳健标准误、多重检验校正、交叉验证）是否必然使回测验证的策略更可信？如何衡量不同验证协议的可靠性，以及如何决定控制手段的叠加顺序与组合？
AI.motivation: 实践者默认每个额外控制都会让策略更可信，但叠加控制可能冗余甚至有害。现有文献缺乏从整体验证协议层面衡量控制组合效果的方法论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将验证协议整体视为单一估计器，以规模（size）和功效（power）为衡量标准，并引入第三维度——验证已验证的已失效边际（已死边缘）的频率。控制冗余与否取决于失败子模式层面的互补性。
AI.method: 蒙特卡洛模拟，植入已知真实信号（planted ground truth），在不同收益制度和重采样方案下比较不同验证协议；先校准到相同规模再比较；测量规模、功效以及协议验证已失效边际的频率。
AI.findings: 控制仅在覆盖已被遗漏的失败模式时提升可靠性；针对同一失败模式叠加两个修正不改变假阳性率且破坏功效；冗余判定在失败子模式层面而非家族层面，同一家族的两个控制仍可互补；在实际搜索规模下，诚实验证使最小可检测边际加倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出以对照组方式衡量验证协议组合效果的方法论框架；建立了控制冗余的判定原则（基于失败子模式层面而非家族层面）；推导出控制组合规则及满足该规则的最优流程类别。
AI.practical_contributions: 发布基准数据集和代码库，供实践者测量自身验证协议的可靠性；提供控制组合的简单规则以构建高效验证流程；量化揭示叠加多余控制会削弱统计功效的实际代价。

title: Does the Itô Correction Contain Independent Predictive Information? Evidence from Regime-Weighted Volatility Dynamics

detail.title: Does the Itô Correction Contain Independent Predictive Information? Evidence from Regime-Weighted Volatility Dynamics
detail.abstract: This paper constructs a dynamic, regime-weighted Ito correction signal from a Hidden Markov Model (HMM) applied to S&P 500 returns and tests its predictive content for future equity returns. The expected volatility drag-weighted by HMM filtered regime probabilities-contains independent predictive information beyond realised volatility and the VIX. Recursive out-of-sample (OOS) tests on 2016-2024 produce R 2 = 2.32%, compared to a benchmark OOS R 2 of-3.47%, confirming genuine predictive gain over the prevailing-mean model. Clark-West tests confirm statistically significant mean squared prediction error (MSPE) reduction (CW = 7.581, p < 0.001). Extended orthogonalisation controlling for GARCH(1,1), momentum, and reversal isolates a 38.2% independent component with amplified predictive power (t =-2.314, p = 0.021). A Chow test confirms the post-2015 period is structurally more predictable (F = 49.82, p < 0.001). Cross-market analysis of twelve equity indices shows bear-regime duration explains 63.8% of cross-sectional variation in signal strength (r = 0.798, p = 0.002), robust to US outlier removal (r = 0.783, p = 0.004), consistent with ambiguity pricing (Epstein and Schneider, 2010). A market-timing strategy achieves a bootstrap-validated Sharpe ratio of 1.342 after conservative transaction costs (p < 0.001), versus-28.3% maximum drawdown compared to-80.3% for buy-and-hold.

AI.tldr: 本文利用隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）对S&P 500收益率构建动态的状态加权Ito校正信号，并检验其对未来股票收益的预测能力。实证发现该信号包含超越已实现波动率和VIX的独立预测信息，样本外R²达到2.32%，Clark-West检验显著（CW=7.581, p<0.001）。正交化分析分离出38.2%的独立预测成分，Chow检验确认2015年后市场结构性更可预测。跨市场分析显示熊市状态持续时间解释了63.8%的信号强度截面差异。基于该信号的市场择时策略在扣除交易成本后实现了1.342的Sharpe比率，最大回撤仅-28.3%，显著优于买入持有策略的-80.3%。
AI.research_question: 基于HMM的状态加权Ito校正信号能否有效预测未来股票收益，其预测能力是否超越现有波动率指标（已实现波动率、VIX）？
AI.motivation: 传统波动率指标（如已实现波动率和VIX）对预期收益的预测能力有限，且预测关系不稳定。Ito校正项反映了波动率对连续复利收益与简单收益之差的系统性影响，结合HMM的状态识别能力可能提取出更优的预测信号，但目前缺乏系统性验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）、Ito校正（波动率拖曳）、模糊性定价理论（Epstein and Schneider, 2010）
AI.method: 采用HMM对S&P 500收益率进行状态识别，构建动态的状态加权Ito校正信号；运用递归样本外预测检验（2016-2024）、Clark-West检验、GARCH(1,1)与动量/反转控制下的正交化分析、Chow结构断点检验、十二个股票指数的跨市场截面回归、以及带自助法验证的择时策略回测。
AI.findings: （1）HMM加权Ito校正信号具有超越已实现波动率和VIX的独立预测信息，样本外R²=2.32%（基准为-3.47%）；（2）正交化后仍保留38.2%的独立预测成分，且预测力增强（t=-2.314, p=0.021）；（3）2015年后市场结构上更可预测（F=49.82, p<0.001）；（4）跨市场中熊市状态持续时间与信号强度高度相关（r=0.798），支持模糊性定价解释；（5）择时策略Sharpe比率达1.342（bootstrap p<0.001），最大回撤-28.3%远优于买入持有的-80.3%。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次将HMM状态概率与Ito校正项结合，为波动率-收益关系提供了新的动态时变刻画框架；（2）从模糊性定价视角解释信号强度的跨国差异，连接了宏观状态识别与行为金融理论；（3）证明了传统波动率指标（已实现波动率和VIX）遗漏了状态依赖的波动率拖曳信息。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供了一个可直接应用于市场择时的可交易信号，在扣除交易成本后仍能实现显著超额收益和更小的最大回撤；（2）为投资者在不同市场状态下调整风险敞口提供了量化依据；（3）跨市场分析结果有助于国际资产配置决策。

title: Does Devaluation Work in Commodity Dependent Currency Unions? Three Decades of Evidence from the CFA Franc Zone

detail.title: Does Devaluation Work in Commodity Dependent Currency Unions? Three Decades of Evidence from the CFA Franc Zone

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declarations of interest: none.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: We analyse the 1994 devaluation of the CFA franc using a panel of 31 African countries (1961-2022), including 11 from the CFA zone, using a difference-indifferences approach with permutation inference. Consistent with rigorous re-evaluations in the recent literature, we find no robust effect on GDP per capita at any time horizon, up to 28 years after the shock. The share of exports in GDP increased by 6.8 percentage points between 1995 and 1999, a robust effect that replicates that of Dillner (2022, +5.0 points) obtained using synthetic controls. The effect is driven by two oil-exporting economies, the Congo and Gabon, a result consistent with an accounting valuation of dollar-denominated exports rather than with a gain in competitiveness. Seven heterogeneity tests fail to explain the zero effect on GDP. These findings warrant caution when considering the benefits of devaluations within monetary unions including primary commodity economies.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1961-2022年31个非洲国家（含11个CFA法郎区国家）的面板数据，采用双重差分法与置换推断，分析1994年CFA法郎贬值的影响。研究发现：贬值对人均GDP在任何时间跨度（最长28年）均无稳健效应；但出口占GDP比重在1995-1999年间提升了6.8个百分点，该效应主要由刚果和加蓬两个石油出口国驱动，反映的是美元计价出口的会计估值效应而非竞争力提升。七个异质性检验均无法解释GDP零效应。研究提醒在包含初级商品经济体的货币联盟中，应审慎看待贬值的收益。
AI.research_question: 1994年CFA法郎贬值对非洲国家（尤其是CFA法郎区成员国）的经济增长和出口表现有何影响？
AI.motivation: 鉴于近期文献对贬值效应的严谨重新评估，需要重新检验1994年CFA法郎贬值这一重大货币冲击的长期经济效应，以厘清贬值在货币联盟中能否带来预期收益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币贬值理论中的竞争力假说与会计估值效应区分；双重差分（DiD）框架下的因果推断；置换推断（permutation inference）用于小样本推断。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（difference-in-differences）搭配置换推断，使用1961-2022年31个非洲国家的面板数据（其中11个为CFA法郎区国家），并进行了七个异质性检验。
AI.findings: （1）贬值对人均GDP在任何时间跨度（最长达28年）均无稳健效应；（2）出口占GDP比重在1995-1999年间显著提升6.8个百分点，该效应复现了Dillner(2022)用合成控制法得到的+5.0个百分点的结果；（3）出口效应完全由刚果和加蓬两个石油出口国驱动，反映美元计价出口的会计估值而非竞争力提升；（4）七个异质性检验均无法解释GDP零效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文通过严谨的因果推断方法（DiD+置换推断）与长时间跨度（28年）的检验，为货币贬值对经济增长无效的论点提供了新的稳健证据，并区分了出口增长中"真实竞争力效应"与"会计估值效应"两种不同机制，深化了对货币联盟中贬值机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究为政策制定者提供了重要警示：在包含初级商品经济体（尤其石油出口国）的货币联盟中，依靠贬值来促进增长和出口的预期可能落空，政策设计应更加审慎。

title: Does AI Governance Pay? † Articulation Styles and Market Trust
affiliations: Faculty of Policy Studies, Chuo University

detail.title: Does AI Governance Pay? † Articulation Styles and Market Trust
detail.abstract: This study examines whether corporate investments in artificial intelligence (AI) governance frameworks pay off in the consumer market by linking corporate disclosure styles with consumer valuations. In Stage 1, we conduct a computational text analysis using Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency vectorization and Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection dimension reduction on the inaugural transparency reports (N = 25) submitted to the Hiroshima AI Process. The results indicate that the communication posture of Japanese enterprises forms a distinct latent profile within this sample, prioritizing formalized organizational oversight and multi-stakeholder risk management over code-level optimization. In Stage 2, these disclosure styles are operationalized into a scenario-based statedpreference survey of Japanese consumers (N = 887) using the contingent valuation method. Selection-corrected estimates suggest that consumers value internal governance rules under routine conditions, but privacy-sensitive respondents discount unverified self-reporting. In higher-price settings, AI-literate respondents who initially prefer the technology-oriented provider demand substantially larger discounts for the governance-oriented alternative, while audited governance functions primarily as a selection prerequisite rather than a continuous willingness-to-pay premium. After a simulated operational failure, ex-ante organizational governance narratives are associated with lower customer attrition, acting as a provider-specific behavioral buffer. These findings clarify the potential and limitations of voluntary AI governance disclosure, providing an empirical basis for policy instruments designed to address information-driven market failures and strengthen co-regulatory safety architectures.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过两阶段设计检验企业AI治理框架披露在消费市场中的价值：第一阶段使用计算文本分析对广岛AI进程提交的首批透明报告（N=25）进行文本挖掘，识别出日本企业独特的沟通姿态；第二阶段运用条件估值法对887名日本消费者进行情境化陈述偏好调查，发现消费者在常规条件下重视内部治理规则，但对未经核实的自我报告持怀疑态度，且审计治理功能主要作为选择前提而非持续溢价。
AI.research_question: 企业AI治理框架的投资能否在消费市场中获得回报？具体而言，企业披露AI治理的方式如何影响消费者的价值评估？
AI.motivation: 随着AI治理成为企业合规的重要议题，自愿性AI治理披露日益普遍，但其市场价值尚不明确。信息驱动的市场失灵可能导致企业缺乏有效的治理披露激励，因此需要实证检验治理披露是否以及如何转化为消费者层面的价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论、信息披露理论、消费者价值评估理论
AI.method: 两阶段混合方法设计：Stage 1采用TF-IDF向量化与UMAP降维的计算文本分析（N=25份透明报告）；Stage 2采用基于情境的陈述偏好调查（N=887）和条件估值法，并进行选择偏差校正。
AI.findings: （1）日本企业的AI治理沟通形成独特的潜在特征，优先关注正式组织监督和多利益相关方风险管理而非代码级优化；（2）常规条件下消费者重视内部治理规则，但隐私敏感型消费者会对未经核实的自我报告打折；（3）高价情境下，AI素养高的消费者对治理导向替代方案要求更大折扣；（4）审计治理功能主要作为选择前提而非持续支付溢价；（5）模拟运营失败后，事前组织治理叙事与更低的客户流失率相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI治理披露与消费者市场价值联系起来，揭示了自愿性AI治理披露的市场局限性和条件性价值，为信号理论在AI治理情境下的适用边界提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业AI治理披露策略提供实证指导，为政策制定者设计应对信息驱动市场失灵的政策工具、强化共同监管安全架构提供经验基础。

title: Fractal Geometry and Anomalous Diffusion in Subsurface Reservoirs: A Critical Review of Oil, Gas and Geothermal Applications
affiliations: ,  Engineering Department of Turkish Petroleum Corporation (TPAO),  Engineering Department of Turkish Petroleum Corporation (TPAO), University of Calgary and Middle East Technical University

detail.title: Fractal Geometry and Anomalous Diffusion in Subsurface Reservoirs: A Critical Review of Oil, Gas and Geothermal Applications

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This review article did not involve human participants, animals, or identifiable personal data, and no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: Fractal geometry provides a rigorous framework for describing the irregularity, heterogeneity, and scale-dependent behavior of subsurface reservoir systems. Fractal concepts have been widely applied to characterize fracture networks, pore-throat structures, pressure-transient responses, anomalous diffusion, multiphase flow, digital-rock properties, and transport processes in complex porous media in oil, gas, and geothermal reservoirs. This review presents a structured and critical synthesis of fractal geometry and anomalous-diffusion approaches in reservoir engineering. Fundamental concepts, including fractal dimension, Euclidean dimension, network topology, random walks, and anomalous transport, are first introduced to establish the theoretical basis. Subsequently, key modeling frameworks-namely the Chang and Yortsos fractal reservoir model, the Metzler fractional-diffusion model, and the Raghavan anomalous-diffusion formulation-are critically discussed with respect to their physical assumptions, model parameters, and applicability. The paper then reviews applications across fracture-dominated geothermal systems, naturally fractured petroleum reservoirs, unconventional and hydraulically fractured reservoirs, pore-scale characterization, multiphase-flow modeling, digital-rock analysis, acidizing, wormhole growth, and production-related applications. Special attention is given to the distinction between geometric fractal parameters derived from images, pore-size distributions, or fracture maps and dynamic anomalous-transport parameters inferred from pressure, production, or tracer data. Finally, limitations related to parameter estimation, scale dependency, model uncertainty, and physical validation are evaluated, and future research directions are proposed, emphasizing integrated multiscale characterization, digital-rock physics, uncertainty quantification, field validation, hybrid data-driven workflows, and coupled multiphysics modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了分形几何与异常扩散方法在油气和地热储层工程中的应用，涵盖理论基础、关键建模框架（Chang-Yortsos分形储层模型、Metzler分数阶扩散模型、Raghavan异常扩散公式）、多场景应用（裂缝性地热系统、天然裂缝油藏、非常规压裂储层、孔隙尺度表征、多相流、数字岩心、酸化等），并深入区分了静态几何分形参数与动态异常输运参数的本质差异，最后评估了参数估计、尺度依赖、模型不确定性等局限并展望了未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 分形几何与异常扩散方法在储层工程中如何被系统化应用？其理论基础、建模框架、应用场景及局限性是什么？
AI.motivation: 储层系统（裂缝网络、孔隙结构、输运过程）具有高度的不规则性、异质性和尺度依赖性，传统欧几里得几何和经典扩散方法难以准确描述。分形几何和异常扩散理论提供了更严谨的数学框架，但相关文献分散且缺乏系统整合，有必要进行全面综述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分形几何理论（分形维数、欧几里得维数、网络拓扑）、随机游走理论、异常输运理论（次扩散/超扩散）、分数阶微积分理论、Chang和Yortsos分形储层模型、Metzler分数阶扩散模型、Raghavan异常扩散公式
AI.method: 系统文献综述方法，对分形几何与异常扩散在储层工程中的应用进行结构化批判性综合。首先建立理论基础，然后批判性讨论三大核心建模框架的物理假设与适用性，再跨多个应用场景进行归类梳理，最后评估局限性并提出研究方向。
AI.findings: （1）分形几何和异常扩散在裂缝性储层、非常规油藏、孔隙尺度表征、多相流、数字岩心、酸化及生产应用等广泛领域均有成功应用；（2）静态几何分形参数（来自图像、孔径分布、裂缝图）与动态异常输运参数（来自压力、产量、示踪剂数据）存在本质区别，需要明确区分；（3）现有模型在参数估计、尺度依赖性和物理验证方面存在显著局限；（4）单一模型难以全面刻画复杂储层，需要多尺度、多学科综合方法。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次系统梳理并批判性比较了三大核心建模框架（Chang-Yortsos、Metzler、Raghavan）的物理假设和适用条件；（2）明确界定了静态几何分形参数与动态异常输运参数的概念范畴和推导来源差异；（3）构建了分形几何与异常扩散在储层工程应用的全景式理论图谱。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为工程师提供了一套选择合适分形/异常扩散模型的决策框架；（2）明确了不同数据来源（图像vs.动态数据）对参数估计的影响，有助于提高储层表征和建模的准确性；（3）指出了混合数据驱动工作流、数字岩心物理和耦合多物理场建模等实用方向；（4）对油气和地热储层的裂缝描述、产能预测和开发方案优化有直接指导意义。

title: Aegis Equity: A Falsification-Driven Framework for Quantitative Trading and Model Risk Management in Investment Banking

detail.title: Aegis Equity: A Falsification-Driven Framework for Quantitative Trading and Model Risk Management in Investment Banking
detail.abstract:
The proliferation of machine learning tools has made it straightforward to construct a quantitative trading strategy that generates impressive historical performance. The same tools have made it equally straightforward to construct a strategy that merely appears to perform well, one whose apparent edge is an artifact of overfitting, data leakage, or multiple testing rather than genuine predictive skill. Distinguishing between the two is the central methodological challenge of applied quantitative finance, and the primary contribution of this thesis.

This research constructs, validates, and deliberately attempts to falsify Aegis Equity, a dual LightGBM classifier trained on 14 endogenous price-and-volume features, applied to the NSE 500 universe with a Beta-Switch regime filter that dynamically allocates capital between stock-picking, index exposure, and defensive cash. The system is evaluated through a pre-registered three-gate falsification protocol in which all thresholds, hypotheses, and decision rules are locked before the out-of-sample window (January 2019 to October 2023) is examined.

Gate 1 confirms the machine learning models possess statistically significant trade-level predictive skill. Gate 2 formally rejects naive portfolio translation, demonstrating that trade-level skill alone is insufficient to generate portfolio-level outperformance during systemic market shocks. Gate 3 confirms that the Beta-Switch regime filter resolves this failure: the validated architecture achieves a Sharpe ratio of 2.2461 against a benchmark Sharpe of 0.7784, clearing a Bonferroni-corrected block bootstrap threshold of p < 0.0166 across all three tested block sizes.

The thesis documents five backtest construction failure modes, narrative inflation, feature-level data leakage, execution logic bugs, temporal scope violations, and statistical misalignment, each detected through artifact-level verification rather than statistical flagging, along with a sixth discarded test whose invalidity is documented rather than hidden. These findings are mapped onto the model governance practices of investment banking institutions, demonstrating that the three-gate protocol is a practical, working implementation of the independent validation principles mandated by regulatory frameworks including SR 11-7.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并严格验证了一个名为Aegis Equity的双LightGBM量化交易系统，通过预先注册的三门证伪协议区分真实预测能力与过拟合/数据泄漏/多重检验造成的外观优势，最终在印度NSE 500股票池中实现夏普比率2.2461，并记录了五种回测构建失败模式及其实践意义。
AI.research_question: 如何严格区分具有真实预测能力的量化交易策略与仅仅"看起来表现优秀"（实为过拟合、数据泄漏或多重检验产物）的策略？
AI.motivation: 机器学习工具的普及使得构建历史绩效亮眼的量化策略变得极为容易，但同样容易构建出仅表面表现出色而实为伪优势的策略。区分两者是应用量化金融领域的核心方法论挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 机器学习预测模型（LightGBM集成学习）；2. 预先注册的证伪协议（pre-registered falsification protocol）；3. Bonferroni校正的块自助法（block bootstrap）多重检验校正；4. 制度回归滤波（Beta-Switch regime filter）；5. 监管框架（如SR 11-7）的独立验证原则。
AI.method: 构建Aegis Equity双LightGBM分类器，使用14个内生价格与成交量特征，应用于NSE 500股票池，配合Beta-Switch制度滤波在选股、指数敞口和防御性现金之间动态配置资本。通过预先注册的三门证伪协议（三门分别在样本外窗口2019年1月至2023年10月检验前锁定所有阈值、假设和决策规则）进行严格评估。
AI.findings: 三门证伪协议结果：(1) 门1确认机器学习模型具有统计显著的交易层面预测能力；(2) 门2正式拒绝了朴素的投资组合转化，证明系统性市场冲击下交易层面能力不足以产生投资组合层面超额表现；(3) 门3确认Beta-Switch制度滤波解决了该问题：验证架构达到夏普比率2.2461（基准为0.7784），在全部三种块大小下均通过Bonferroni校正的块自助法阈值（p < 0.0166）。此外记录了五种回测构建失败模式（叙事膨胀、特征层面数据泄漏、执行逻辑缺陷、时间范围违规、统计错配）及一个被丢弃的失效测试。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个系统化的三门证伪协议，将预先注册假设、多重检验校正和块自助法检验整合为连贯的方法论框架，为量化金融中的策略验证提供了超越传统统计标记的伪证框架；证明交易层面技能与投资组合层面表现之间存在根本性鸿沟，需制度滤波来弥合。
AI.practical_contributions: 文档化五种回测构建失败模式及其检测方法，为从业者提供了可操作的伪证实践指南；将三门协议映射到投行机构模型治理实践，证明其是SR 11-7等监管框架所要求的独立验证原则的实用化实施。

title: No Test, No Claim: Untested Code is Vibed Code Verification as the Price Signal of Correctness

detail.title: No Test, No Claim: Untested Code is Vibed Code Verification as the Price Signal of Correctness
detail.abstract:
When a large language model writes code we do not trust, we tend to blame the author: a machine wrote it, so it must be suspect. This paper argues that the instinct points at the wrong variable. What makes code trustworthy is not who wrote it but whether reproducible evidence exists that it does what it claims.

Authorship is inert; verification is everything. We defend one thesis - untested code is vibed code, whether a human or a model wrote it - and build it as a single argument rather than a tour of disciplines.

We begin where the argument is strongest: a correctness claim about untested code has no content. It is an unsigned promise (Design by Contract), an unfalsifiable assertion (Popper), and, in Alf Ross's sense, a tû-tû -- a bookkeeping word that connects a wish to a reliance while denoting nothing in between - because the theory that would give it content, in Naur's sense, never leaves the author's head.

Authorship cannot supply that content: a private, perishable understanding is, on Nozick's truth-tracking account, a belief that would persist even if the code were broken, which is to say not knowledge at all, and  the human author and the model collapse into the same case. A program's real
law is its behavior in execution - the legal realists' law in action - not the paper rules of its names, types, and comments; the test is the court decision that discloses it. What running on vibes costs is then contested ground: the cost splits cleanly into a part that can be priced and a part that
cannot.

Chicago prices the first (the Learned Hand formula renders a cheap omitted test negligent by construction; the market for lemons explains why
untested modules cannot be told from working ones); Austrian marks the limit of the second (the calculation problem; dispersed, tacit knowledge) -- and the test is what a decision-maker needs at exactly that boundary, the decentralized feedback signal that substitutes for a global correctness calculation no one can perform. We make the cost concrete with a compound-Poisson actuarial model, of which the Hand formula is the point-estimate special case, and an estimable panel specification, then bound its pretensions with the Austrian caveat that its parameters are guesses at a moving target. The practical contribution follows from that model. Because operational-risk capital under Basel II and Solvency II is itself a
compound-Poisson loss distribution, a test is an operational-risk control with a measurable effect on regulatory capital; the Learned Hand formula is the deterministic point estimate of that model's pure premium; and the industry's faith in "battle-tested" code systematically under-reserves the tail in which latent security failures -- Dirty COW, the XZ backdoor -- actually live, because production tenure samples the body of the loss distribution and never it's tail.

Under every step the same verdict returns, and none of them can find authorship on the relevant side of the ledger.

AI.tldr: 本文论证"未经测试的代码即是"vibed code"（凭感觉的代码）"，无论出自人类还是大语言模型之手。作者身份（authorship）在可信度问题上无关紧要，真正重要的是可复现的验证证据。文章从设计契约、波普尔证伪主义、Ross的tû-tû概念、Naur的理论、Nozick的真理追踪、法律现实主义"行动中的法律"等跨学科视角构建单一论证，并用复合泊松精算模型量化未经测试代码的成本，连接Learned Hand公式、柠檬市场、奥地利学派计算问题，为软件验证提供理论依据和实践工具。
AI.research_question: 当大型语言模型编写的代码不被信任时，责任的指向是否应该是"作者"？什么才是使代码可信的真正决定性因素？代码可信度的核心变量是作者身份还是可验证的实证证据？
AI.motivation: 现实中人们倾向于因为代码由机器编写就对其产生怀疑，而论文认为这种直觉指向了错误的变量。作者身份是惰性的（inert），验证才是一切。需要建立一个统一的论证框架来证明未经测试的代码无论是谁写的都不可信。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Design by Contract（设计契约论）；2. Popper的证伪主义；3. Alf Ross的tû-tû概念（簿记词理论）；4. Naur的理论（关于程序的理论须在作者脑中）；5. Nozick的真理追踪理论（truth-tracking）；6. 法律现实主义（law in action vs paper rules）；7. Learned Hand公式（过失判定）；8. Akerlof柠檬市场理论；9. 奥地利经济学派计算问题（哈耶克）；10. 复合泊松过程（精算模型）；11. Basel II/Solvency II操作风险资本框架
AI.method: 本文采用跨学科理论论证与形式化建模相结合的方法：首先通过哲学和法学的概念工具进行概念分析，构建"未经测试代码无内容"的论证；其次建立复合泊松精算模型将Learned Hand公式作为点估计特例纳入；最后提出可估计的面板数据规格（panel specification），以量化测试对监管资本的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 未经测试的代码其正确性宣称无内容可言——它既是不具名的承诺，也是不可证伪的断言，更是Ross意义上的tû-tû（连接愿望与依赖却不指代任何中间实体的簿记词）。2. 作者身份无法提供这种内容：人类作者与模型在Nozick真理追踪框架下塌缩为同一情形——即使代码坏了信念依然持续，不构成知识。3. 测试如同司法判决，揭示的是"行动中的法律"而非"纸面规则"。4. 代码"凭感觉运行"的成本可分为可定价部分（Learned Hand公式、柠檬市场）与不可定价部分（奥地利学派计算问题）。5. 生产环境服役时长（"battle-tested"）只能采样损失分布的主体而永远无法触及尾部，导致Dirty COW、XZ后门等潜在安全失败被系统性低估储备。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将软件可信度问题从"作者身份"范式重构为"验证证据"范式，提出了题眼性论点：未测试的代码就是vibed code，无论作者是人类还是模型。2. 用Ross的tû-tû概念为"未经测试代码的正确性宣称"提供了一个语言学-哲学的结构性诊断。3. 将Learned Hand公式从法经济学语境引入软件验证领域，并将其重构为复合泊松模型的点估计特例，实现了法经济学与精算理论的统一。4. 弥合了芝加哥学派（可定价部分）与奥地利学派（不可定价部分）之间的理论张力，将测试定位为二者的边界决策信号。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为软件测试提供了一套可量化的经济论证：测试作为操作风险控制手段，对Basel II/Solvency II监管资本具有可测量的影响。2. 揭示了行业"battle-tested"信念的系统性缺陷——生产服役时长无法覆盖尾部风险，为安全测试投入提供了资本充足率层面的依据。3. 提供了复合泊松模型与可估计的面板规格，使企业能够以精算方法评估测试投资的资本节省效应。4. 为AI生成代码的治理提供了新的监管思路：关注验证证据而非来源身份。

title: Dynamic Income-Oriented Pension Investment Model
affiliations: Comenius University - Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics; Department of Applied Mathematics and Statistics

detail.title: Dynamic Income-Oriented Pension Investment Model
detail.abstract: We present a stochastic dynamic model of retirement saving with maximization of the expected utility of pension income. In contrast to traditional models, we change the paradigm from value-oriented to incomeoriented. The model uses SeLFIES (Standard-of-Living Forward-starting Income-only Securities) as risk-free assets. SeLFIES has a dened stream of payments starting at retirement for a dened period. Payments are indexed by consumption per capita or ination from the time of issuance. The paradigm change from value-oriented to income-oriented causes a change in the risk ranking of assets. Government bonds with longer maturities are less risky assets compared to those with shorter maturities. We present the optimal level of savings in the form of a certainty equivalent and an internal rate of return of the certainty equivalent. In addition, we calculate the time evolution of the optimal allocation of investments into dierent types of assets. Optimal saving strategies deliver satisfactory replacement rates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个随机动态退休储蓄模型，以退休后养老金收入的期望效用最大化为目标，将传统面向价值的范式转变为面向收入的范式。模型使用SeLFIES（生活标准前瞻性收入证券）作为无风险资产，该证券提供从退休开始的固定支付流，并按人均消费或通胀指数化。范式转变导致资产风险排序发生变化——长期政府债券比短期债券风险更低。论文给出了最优储蓄水平（确定性等价及其内部收益率），并计算了最优投资配置的时间演化，结果显示最优储蓄策略能获得令人满意的替代率。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个以收入为导向而非以价值为导向的退休储蓄随机动态模型，并利用SeLFIES作为无风险资产来优化养老金收入预期效用？
AI.motivation: 传统退休储蓄模型以价值为导向（value-oriented），关注资产组合的市场价值最大化，但退休人员真正关心的是退休后的收入水平。传统模型忽略了从积累期到领取期收入转换的重要性，导致风险认知和资产配置策略可能偏离实际需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机动态规划；养老金收入期望效用最大化；收入导向范式（income-oriented paradigm）；确定性等价（certainty equivalent）与内部收益率框架
AI.method: 建立随机动态退休储蓄模型，以养老金收入期望效用最大化为目标函数，使用SeLFIES作为无风险资产，推导最优储蓄水平（以确定性等价和内部收益率形式），并计算最优投资配置随时间演化的路径。
AI.findings: 从价值导向转变为收入导向后，资产风险排序发生变化：长期政府债券比短期政府债券风险更低。最优储蓄策略能够产生令人满意的替代率（replacement rates）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从价值导向到收入导向的退休储蓄模型范式转变；揭示了范式转变对资产风险排序的根本性影响（长期债券变为低风险资产）；扩展了确定性等价和内部收益率在养老金储蓄规划中的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为退休储蓄者提供了面向收入的资产配置策略指引；引入SeLFIES作为一种新型无风险资产工具，帮助投资者锁定退休后收入；提供了最优储蓄水平的量化估算方法和投资配置的时间演化路径。

title: How Do Shock-Dependent Phillips Curve Dynamics Shape Economic Growth and Exchange Rate Behavior: Evidence from Some African Countries
affiliations: Sudan University of Science and Technology

detail.title: How Do Shock-Dependent Phillips Curve Dynamics Shape Economic Growth and Exchange Rate Behavior: Evidence from Some African Countries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: In this paper, we study the impact of a shock-dependent Phillips Curve on growth and exchange rate dynamics in six African countries from 1980 to 2024. In contrast to the standard Phillips Curve, this model permits the inflation-output trade-off to depend on the type of structural shocks, allowing for nonlinear and state-contingent relations in the macroeconomy. The novel empirical toolkit developed for this analysis utilizes Panel SVAR, Conditional Inverse Rosenblatt (CIR)-based impulse responses, and Panel Generalized Linear Models (GLM) to systematically explore short-and medium-term transmission mechanisms across diverse economies. The results exhibit considerable crosscountry heterogeneity. The shock-driven Phillips Curve has a statistically significant negative impact on growth in South Africa, Nigeria, Egypt, and Algeria, with the influence on Ethiopia and Uganda being weak/insignificant, an indication of structural rigidities and feeble monetary transmission. Exchange rate responses tend to be temporary and differ across regimes, being stronger in more open and financially integrated countries. Impulse response analysis shows that inflation shocks transitorily raise output and exchange rate volatility, but these effects vanish as predicted by the long-run neutrality. These results suggest that macroeconomic relationships in African countries are nonlinear, heterogeneous, and state-dependent, which have implications for the design of monetary policy and the conduct of macroeconomic stabilization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1980-2024年间六个非洲国家中冲击依赖型菲利普斯曲线对增长和汇率动态的影响，发现宏观经济关系是非线性、异质性和状态依赖的。
AI.research_question: 冲击依赖型菲利普斯曲线如何影响六个非洲国家的经济增长和汇率动态？
AI.motivation: 标准的菲利普斯曲线假设通胀-产出权衡是固定的，但现实中这种权衡可能取决于结构性冲击的类型。本文旨在超越标准模型，探索非洲国家宏观经济中非线性、状态依赖的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 冲击依赖型菲利普斯曲线（Shock-dependent Phillips Curve），该模型允许通胀-产出权衡随结构性冲击类型而变化。
AI.method: 使用了三种实证方法：面板结构向量自回归（Panel SVAR）、基于条件逆罗森布拉特（CIR）的脉冲响应函数、以及面板广义线性模型（Panel GLM），以系统性地探索不同经济体中的短期和中期传导机制。
AI.findings: （1）冲击驱动型菲利普斯曲线对南非、尼日利亚、埃及和阿尔及利亚的增长有统计显著的负面影响，而对埃塞俄比亚和乌干达的影响微弱或不显著；（2）汇率响应是暂时性的，且在更开放和金融一体化程度更高的国家中更强；（3）通胀冲击暂时提高了产出和汇率波动性，但长期中性效应使这些影响最终消失；（4）结果呈现显著的跨国异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为冲击依赖型菲利普斯曲线提供了非洲国家的实证证据，证明了宏观经济关系是非线性、异质性和状态依赖的，挑战了标准菲利普斯曲线线性均质关系的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲国家货币政策设计和宏观经济稳定政策提供了重要启示，表明政策制定需要考虑国家的结构性特征和冲击的异质性。

title: Quantitative Credit Risk Modeling and Failure Analytics: A Historical Comparative Discriminant Case Study of Pakistan's Cement Sector

detail.title: Quantitative Credit Risk Modeling and Failure Analytics: A Historical Comparative Discriminant Case Study of Pakistan's Cement Sector
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the quantitative credit risk dynamics and corporate insolvency forecasting within Pakistan's heavy manufacturing domain through an empirical historical evaluation of the cement sector over the financial years 2017 to 2019. Capital-intensive industrial sectors in emerging economies face severe structural vulnerabilities driven by macroeconomic volatility, debt-servicing burdens, and cyclical revenue shocks. Utilizing Edward I. Altman's Five-Factor Multivariate Discriminant Analysis (MDA) Z-Score architecture, this study evaluates the solvency profiles, operational efficiencies, and leverage stability of five dominant listed cement manufacturers: Lucky Cement Limited, D.G. Khan Cement Company Limited, Kohat Cement Company Limited, Maple Leaf Cement Factory Limited, and Attock Cement (Pakistan) Limited. Empirical findings reveal a pronounced, systemic deterioration in financial stability across the three-year horizon. The sample's composite mean Z-score contracted sharply from a robust "Safe" baseline of 4.48 in FY2017 to a transitional "Grey" state of 2.86 in FY2018, ultimately plunging into the "Distress" threshold at 1.51 in FY2019. Working capital compression (X1) and collapsing equity-to-liability ratios (X4) served as the primary quantitative catalysts driving firm-level distress. This research advances financial engineering applications in corporate risk management by highlighting the diagnostic efficacy of multi-ratio linear discriminant algorithms for pre-emptive insolvency engineering in emerging markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用Altman五因子Z-Score模型，对巴基斯坦水泥行业五家龙头上市公司2017-2019年间的信用风险动态与破产预测进行了实证分析，发现行业整体财务稳定性呈现系统性恶化趋势，综合Z值从2017年的4.48（安全区）骤降至2019年的1.51（破产区），营运资本压缩与权益负债比崩塌是主要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦重工业制造领域（以水泥行业为代表）的定量信用风险动态如何演变？Altman五因子Z-Score模型能否有效预测新兴市场中企业的破产风险？
AI.motivation: 资本密集型工业部门在新兴经济体中面临宏观经济波动、偿债负担和周期性收入冲击带来的结构性脆弱性，亟需通过实证量化评估其信用风险与破产概率。
AI.theoretical_framework: Edward I. Altman的五因子多元判别分析（MDA）Z-Score模型
AI.method: 采用Altman五因子Z-Score模型，对巴基斯坦五家上市水泥企业（Lucky Cement、D.G. Khan Cement、Kohat Cement、Maple Leaf Cement、Attock Cement）2017-2019财年的财务报表数据进行多元判别分析，评估其偿债能力、运营效率和杠杆稳定性。
AI.findings: 样本综合平均Z值从FY2017的4.48（安全区）降至FY2018的2.86（灰色区），再进一步跌至FY2019的1.51（破产区）；营运资本比率（X1）和权益负债比（X4）的崩塌是企业陷入财务困境的主要量化催化剂。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了多比率线性判别算法在新兴市场破产预警中的诊断有效性，推进了多比率线性判别算法在企业风险管理中的应用，拓展了Z-Score模型在新兴经济体重工业领域的适用性证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场资本密集型行业的预发性破产工程提供了实证依据，有助于企业风险管理实践中的早期预警与信贷决策。

title:
Value Creation in Cross-Border European Mid-Market M&A
Governance, Pricing Discipline and Capability-Preserving Integration

detail.title:
Value Creation in Cross-Border European Mid-Market M&A
Governance, Pricing Discipline and Capability-Preserving Integration

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known financial or personal relationships, competing interests or other circumstances that could have influenced, or could reasonably be perceived to have influenced, the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this study does not involve human participants, personal data, interviews or experimental procedures. The analysis relies exclusively on publicly available academic literature, corporate reports, transaction materials and other secondary sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Cross-border mergers and acquisitions are a central route to scale, capability acquisition and market entry in Europe, yet their outcomes vary sharply. This paper develops an exploratory process-capability framework for analysing value creation in the European mid-market, where founder ownership, limited public information, thin management structures and institutional heterogeneity make execution especially consequential. The study combines an integrative review of the strategy, corporate finance and postmerger integration literature with descriptive secondary market evidence and a comparative analysis of three deliberately selected boundary cases: Amplifon-GAES, Lavazza-Carte Noire and Aryzta-Picard. The paper does not treat the cases as a representative sample. Instead, it uses them to elaborate six propositions concerning governance fit, origination advantage, the bankability of improvements, contingent deal structure, preservation-first integration and codified acquisition learning. The central argument is that acquirer value is not explained by strategic rationale alone. It depends on whether control rights match the intended value-creation mechanism; whether the buyer has an information or process advantage before signing; whether the price reflects only improvements that are sufficiently within the buyer's control; and whether integration protects the tacit and relational capabilities that justified the acquisition. The framework contributes a practical bridge between M&A process research and valuation discipline and identifies testable implications for corporate acquirers, private equity sponsors and advisers operating in fragmented European markets.

AI.tldr: 本文通过探索性的过程-能力框架分析欧洲中型市场跨境并购中的价值创造，提出并购方价值不仅取决于战略逻辑，更取决于控制权匹配、签约前的信息和流程优势、价格是否仅反映买方可控的改进，以及整合是否保护了促成收购的隐性及关系型能力。
AI.research_question: 在欧洲中型市场中，是什么因素决定了跨境并购中收购方价值的创造？为何相似的战略并购结果差异显著？
AI.motivation: 跨境并购是欧洲企业扩张、能力获取和市场进入的核心途径，但并购结果差异极大。现有研究多聚焦于战略逻辑或财务估值，缺乏对执行过程如何影响价值创造的整合理解，尤其是在创始人所有权、信息不对称、管理结构薄弱和制度异质性突出的欧洲中型市场中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 过程-能力框架（process-capability framework），整合战略管理、公司金融和并购后整合（PMI）文献，强调治理适配、发起优势、可银行化的改进、或有交易结构、保存优先整合和编码化的并购学习六个维度。
AI.method: 整合性文献综述、描述性二手市场证据，以及对三个有意选择的边界案例（Amplifon-GAES、Lavazza-Carte Noire、Aryzta-Picard）的比较分析。
AI.findings: 提出六项命题：治理适配、发起优势、改进的可银行化、或有交易结构、保存优先整合、编码化并购学习。核心结论是收购方价值并非仅由战略逻辑决定，而取决于控制权与价值创造机制是否匹配、签约前买方是否拥有信息或流程优势、价格是否仅反映买方充分可控的改进、以及整合是否保护了支撑收购的隐性及关系型能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了连接并购过程研究与估值纪律的实用桥梁，提出可检验的命题，为并购过程如何影响价值创造提供了系统性理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲分散市场中的企业收购方、私募股权基金和顾问提供了可操作的分析框架和实践指引，帮助其识别价值创造的关键执行条件。

title:
Three Neighbours, Three Trajectories

Iran (Islamic Republic Of), Saudi Arabia and Türkiye Development Comparison, 1990 to 2023

detail.title:
Three Neighbours, Three Trajectories

Iran (Islamic Republic Of), Saudi Arabia and Türkiye Development Comparison, 1990 to 2023

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study relies exclusively on publicly available secondary data and did not involve human participants, primary fieldwork, interviews or surveys, and therefore did not require research ethics committee approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This report compares the human development of three neighbouring Middle Eastern states, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Saudi Arabia and Türkiye, across the period 1990 to 2023, using a full annual data series drawn primarily from the United Nations Development Programme's Human Development Report 2025 and the World Bank's World Development Indicators.
