detail.abstract: Helping professionals constantly struggle to navigate the complexities of ethical dilemmas while promoting just and equitable policies in the current unstable political environment. With emphasis on how social workers and other helping professionals can evaluate and resolve conflicting policies to advance social justice, this essay examines how moral courage and adaptive leadership are essential to this work. Drawing on an ethical decision-making model and incorporating Afrocentric principles such as humanistic values and autonomy, the essay provides a framework for understanding the empowerment and selfdetermination necessary for effective advocacy. Reflecting on these concepts can help professionals sharpen their approach to ethical leadership and drive meaningful change. The essay concludes with three thought-provoking questions to strengthen ethical advocacy and decision-making in today's politically volatile world.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了助人专业人员在当前不稳定政治环境中应对伦理困境、促进公正平等政策时所必需的道德勇气与适应性领导力。论文将伦理决策模型与非洲中心主义原则（人本主义价值观与自主性）相结合，提出了理解赋权与自决的框架，以支持有效的倡导工作。
AI.research_question: 助人专业人员（如社会工作者）如何在当前不稳定的政治环境中评估和解决相互冲突的政策，以促进社会正义？道德勇气与适应性领导力在其中发挥何种作用？
AI.motivation: 助人专业人员持续面临在复杂伦理困境中实践、并在当前不稳定的政治环境中推动公正平等政策的挑战，需要一个整合性框架来指导其伦理领导与倡导工作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 伦理决策模型；非洲中心主义原则（人本主义价值观、自主性）；赋权与自决理论；道德勇气与适应性领导力理论
AI.method: 概念性/规范性论文（essay），通过理论整合与反思性分析构建框架，并提出三个发人深省的问题以强化伦理倡导与决策。
AI.findings: 论文提出一个整合伦理决策模型与非洲中心主义原则的框架，强调道德勇气与适应性领导力是助人专业人员在冲突政策中推进社会正义的关键；反思这些概念有助于专业人员精进伦理领导方法并推动有意义的变革。
AI.theory_contributions: 将非洲中心主义原则（人本主义价值观与自主性）融入伦理决策模型，为理解赋权与自决在伦理倡导中的角色提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社会工作者及其他助人专业人员提供了评估和解决冲突政策的具体框架，并提出了三个思考性问题，帮助从业人员在实际工作中强化伦理倡导与决策能力。

title: When Timestamp Rounding Changes Bottleneck Rankings

detail.title: When Timestamp Rounding Changes Bottleneck Rankings
detail.abstract: Manufacturing event logs often record activity starts and completions on a coarse time grid. A grid that is adequate for trace visualization may be inadequate for ranking stations by mean activity duration. This paper isolates that measurement effect in a transparent synthetic five-station flow line. Four hundred latent logs are paired with 1-, 5-, and 10-minute rounded views using common random numbers. Direct ranking changes the top station in 4.5%, 19.0%, and 30.25% of the paired logs, respectively. At 10 minutes, the mean absolute error in case span is 3.331 minutes and 35.32% of recorded activities have zero duration. A local constrained-jitter procedure is then used to report a probability set instead of forcing a total ranking. At the 10-minute grid it makes a definitive declaration in 7.25% of logs, while wrong definitive declarations occur in 0.25% and the reported set covers the latent top station in 98.50%. The procedure functions as an ambiguity diagnostic rather than a reconstruction of lost timestamps. Sensitivity experiments show that larger logs and clearer station separation reduce reversals, whereas near ties and coarse grids are failure boundaries. The computational evidence targets the modeled setting and supports a practical rule: preserve the finest available timestamps and attach an ambiguity report whenever operational rankings are derived from rounded event data.

AI.tldr: 本文通过仿真实验证明，制造事件日志中的时间粗粒度取整会显著影响基于平均活动时长的工位排名，并提出一种局部约束抖动程序生成概率性排名集合作为模糊性诊断工具，而非试图重建丢失的时间戳。
AI.research_question: 制造事件日志中，时间网格粒度对基于平均活动时长的工位排名有何影响？以及如何应对这种测量效应？
AI.motivation: 制造事件日志通常以粗粒度时间网格记录活动的开始和完成时间，这种网格对轨迹可视化可能足够，但对按平均活动时长对工位排名可能不够精确，导致排名失真。
AI.theoretical_framework: 测量效应理论、常见随机数（common random numbers）配对实验设计、统计排名与概率集合推断。
AI.method: 构建透明的五工位流水线仿真模型，生成400个潜在日志，分别以1、5、10分钟粒度取整，使用常见随机数进行配对；提出局部约束抖动（local constrained-jitter）程序来生成排名概率集合。
AI.findings: 直接排名在1、5、10分钟粒度下分别有4.5%、19.0%、30.25%的日志改变榜首工位；10分钟粒度下案例跨度平均绝对误差为3.331分钟，35.32%的活动记录持续时间为零；抖动程序在10分钟粒度下仅7.25%日志能做出明确判定，错误明确判定仅0.25%，报告集合覆盖潜在榜首工位的命中率达98.50%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将时间取整测量效应系统性地引入业务流程/制造分析的排名问题，提出以概率集合替代强制总排序的方法论，明确区分测量诊断与时间戳重建的界限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供可操作规则：保留最细粒度的时间戳，并建议在基于取整事件数据推导运营排名时附加模糊性报告；为流程挖掘排名结果的可靠性提供量化警示。

title: Drivers of Adoption of Forensic Accounting Practices in the Nigerian Financial Sector: The Health Belief Model Perspective
affiliations: De Montfort University

detail.title: Drivers of Adoption of Forensic Accounting Practices in the Nigerian Financial Sector: The Health Belief Model Perspective

keywords: Perceived Susceptibility and Health Belief Model (HBM)

detail.abstract: Purpose-The study focuses on the financial institutions in Nigeria from the lens of Health Belief Model (HBM). It aims to investigate the drivers influencing the adoption of forensic accounting practices in the context of fraud perspective drivers in the Nigerian Financial Sector. Design/methodology/approach-Data were collected via survey questionnaire and confirmatory factor analysis and structural equation modelling were used to examine the model fit and the hypotheses, respectively. SMARTPLS 4.0 software was used for data analysis. Quantitative analysis was carried out to examine how fraud perspective drivers from organisational context influence the behavioural intention to adopt forensic accounting practices. Findings-This study found that both fraud perspective drivers-Perceived Severity of fraud and Perceived Susceptibility of fraud in financial institutions are significant drivers of the adoption of forensic accounting practices. Additionally, the study found that perceived susceptibility of fraud has a stronger correlation with adoption of forensic accounting practices based on its t-statistic and β value in comparison to perceived severity of fraud. Research limitations/implications-Data collection in financial institutions is always difficult because of their reluctant to give away information. Many of the participants were sceptical of the mission of the researcher due to the sensitivity of the questions being asked thereby limiting the number of samples collected. The importance of forensic accounting has grown in tandem with the rise in financial crimes. By implication, forensic accounting adoption is crucial in the implementation of proactive measures to prevent, detect and mitigate fraud in the Nigerian Financial Sector and management must recognise this importance. Originality/value-To the best of this researcher's knowledge, there has been no study conducted to investigate the drivers influencing the adoption of forensic accounting practices in the context of financial institutions in the Nigerian Financial Sector and from the theoretical lens of Health Belief Model (HBM).

AI.tldr: 本研究以健康信念模型（HBM）为理论框架，探讨尼日利亚金融机构中影响法务会计实务采纳的欺诈视角驱动因素。研究发现欺诈感知严重性和欺诈感知易感性均显著影响法务会计的采纳行为，其中感知易感性的影响更强。
AI.research_question: 在尼日利亚金融部门中，哪些欺诈视角驱动因素会影响法务会计实务的采纳行为？
AI.motivation: 金融犯罪日益增长的背景下，法务会计的重要性不断提升，但尚无研究从健康信念模型（HBM）视角考察尼日利亚金融机构中法务会计实务采纳的驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康信念模型（Health Belief Model, HBM），聚焦于欺诈感知严重性（Perceived Severity）和欺诈感知易感性（Perceived Susceptibility）两个核心维度。
AI.method: 采用问卷调查法收集数据，使用SPSS/SMARTPLS 4.0软件进行数据分析，通过验证性因子分析（CFA）检验模型拟合度，并运用结构方程模型（SEM）检验研究假设，进行定量分析。
AI.findings: 欺诈感知严重性和欺诈感知易感性均是尼日利亚金融机构采纳法务会计实务的显著驱动因素；其中欺诈感知易感性对法务会计采纳的影响（基于t统计量和β值）强于欺诈感知严重性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将健康信念模型（HBM）应用于尼日利亚金融部门法务会计采纳研究，拓展了HBM在欺诈预防与法务会计领域的理论适用性，填补了该领域的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚金融机构管理层提供实证依据，强调认可和重视欺诈感知易感性与严重性对实施预防、检测和减轻欺诈的前瞻性措施具有重要意义，有助于推动法务会计的有效采纳。

title: Financial Civil Death Before Conviction: Liberty, Economic Exclusion, and the Constitutional Limits of Debanking

detail.title: Financial Civil Death Before Conviction: Liberty, Economic Exclusion, and the Constitutional Limits of Debanking

keywords: and the Constitutional Limits of Debanking

detail.abstract:
This article develops the concept of financial civil death before conviction to describe a condition in which individuals are excluded from essential financial infrastructure prior to any criminal conviction or formal adjudication of wrongdoing. In modern financialized economies, access to banking systems functions as a gateway condition for economic participation, enabling individuals to receive wages, secure housing, access credit, and engage in digital commerce.

The article argues that contemporary debanking practices—while formally grounded in private contractual discretion and regulatory compliance regimes—may produce exclusionary effects that are functionally analogous to historical doctrines of civil death, banishment, and legal-social exclusion. However, unlike traditional forms of legal exclusion, modern financial exclusion operates through infrastructural dependency rather than formal status deprivation.

Drawing on legal history, constitutional theory, financial regulation, and socio-legal scholarship, the article traces the evolution of exclusion from territorial and status-based systems to contemporary infrastructural systems governed through AML/KYC frameworks and risk-based financial governance. It further examines the hybrid nature of modern banking institutions, which operate as private actors executing public regulatory functions.

The article concludes that pre-conviction financial exclusion raises unresolved constitutional questions concerning liberty, dignity, procedural fairness, and proportionality in modern financial systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"定罪前金融民事死亡"概念，描述个体在未经刑事定罪或正式裁决前即被排除在基本金融基础设施之外的现象。文章认为当代"去银行化"实践虽形式上基于私人合同自由与合规监管，但其排斥效应在功能上类似于历史上的民事死亡、流放等法律—社会排斥制度。与传统的法律排斥不同，现代金融排斥通过基础设施依赖而非正式身份剥夺运作。文章指出，定罪前的金融排斥引发了关于自由、尊严、程序公正和比例原则等未解决的宪法问题。
AI.research_question: 在未经刑事定罪或正式裁决之前，个体被排除在基本金融基础设施之外（即"定罪前金融民事死亡"）在法律和宪政层面意味着什么？这种排斥如何不同于传统形式的法律排斥，并引发何种宪法问题？
AI.motivation: 在当代金融化经济中，银行系统准入是经济参与的门槛条件。当代"去银行化"实践虽然形式上植根于私人合同自由和合规监管，但其排斥效应在功能上类似于历史上的民事死亡、流放和法律—社会排斥制度，这一现象尚未得到充分的理论化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律史（civil death、banishment等历史排斥学说）、宪法理论（自由、尊严、程序公正、比例原则）、金融监管理论（AML/KYC框架与风险导向金融治理）、社会法律研究（socio-legal scholarship）及公私混合治理理论（银行作为执行公共监管职能的私人主体）。
AI.method: 跨学科法律分析方法，综合运用法律史、宪法理论、金融监管和社会法律学术研究，追踪排斥制度从地域性和身份性体系向当代以AML/KYC框架和风险导向金融治理为基础的基础设施性体系的演变。
AI.findings: （1）现代金融排斥通过基础设施依赖而非正式身份剥夺运作，其功能效应与历史上的民事死亡和流放制度具有类比性；（2）现代银行机构具有公私混合性质，作为私人主体执行公共监管功能；（3）定罪前金融排斥引发关于自由、尊严、程序公正和比例原则的未解决的宪法问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并系统阐述了"定罪前金融民事死亡"这一原创性概念，将传统法律排斥理论（民事死亡、流放）与当代金融基础设施排斥联系起来，揭示了排斥制度从地域/身份为基础向基础设施为基础的范式转变，丰富了公私混合治理与金融排斥的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者和监管者审视"去银行化"实践的宪法边界提供理论依据，提示在AML/KYC合规框架下需要关注个体自由、程序公正和比例原则的保障，为金融监管改革提供政策参考。

title: Strategic Governance as a Service: More Governance Has Not Produced Better Governance

detail.title: Strategic Governance as a Service: More Governance Has Not Produced Better Governance
detail.abstract:
Global spending on governance, risk and compliance runs at roughly USD 72 billion a year, growing above 13 per cent. The frequency and severity of governance failure has not fallen. Boeing, Wirecard, Silicon Valley Bank, Credit Suisse and the Post Office each operated with a board, an audit committee, an internal audit function, external auditors and a regulator. In each case all five layers were present, and all five failed. This paper names that contradiction the Governance Paradox and argues that it has an identifiable cause and a structural remedy.

The cause is three defects in how oversight is delivered. Boards engage with risk episodically, on quarterly reporting cycles that risk itself does not respect, so they see the risk environment as it stood at the last reporting date. Board decision-making is structurally biased toward consensus over resilience, a bounded-rationality problem compounded by the decision noise Kahneman, Sibony and Sunstein document. And no permanent function holds an explicit mandate to challenge assumptions before they fail. Internal audit allocates 75 per cent of its capacity to routine assurance (IIA Vision 2035), and 73 per cent of second-line risk functions report funding constraints on emerging-risk identification.

The paper tests these defects against five extended case studies and against the empirical record of 669 listed companies in Germany, Austria and Switzerland (Hunziker et al., 2025), in which 32 per cent suffered at least one severe crisis between 2018 and 2024. Strategy and external risk drove more than 80 per cent of those events; preventable internal risk accounted for 19.2 per cent. Affected firms recovered to approximately 103 per cent of pre-crisis value after 24 months while benchmark indices reached 115 per cent, a persistent recovery gap of some twelve percentage points that reframes governance investment as value preservation. The paper maps regulatory convergence across the United Kingdom, European Union and United States, including Provision 29 of the UK Corporate Governance Code, the Senior Managers and Certification Regime, DORA, the CSDDD and the Delaware Caremark line of cases, toward oversight capabilities the prevailing model cannot supply.

It then sets out Strategic Governance as a Service (SGaaS): a continuous, adversarial, principal-led governance function retained at board level, with a defined methodology of red team protocol, risk simulation and pre-mortem diagnostic, and a four-tier delivery architecture from diagnostic through to pre-exit engagement. SGaaS complements the Three Lines Model without displacing it, occupying the value gap the model leaves open between mandate and delivered capacity.

The paper makes no claim that SGaaS would have prevented the failures it documents. It claims that the architecture described would have changed the information available to decision-makers, and the timing at which that information arrived.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"治理悖论"概念——尽管全球每年在治理、风险与合规上花费约720亿美元且以13%以上的速度增长，治理失败的频率和严重程度并未下降（如波音、Wirecard、硅谷银行等案例中五层治理机制全部失效）。论文将原因归结为监督交付中的三个缺陷（董事会风险参与的间歇性、决策偏向共识而非韧性、缺乏持续挑战假设的职能），并提出了"战略治理即服务"（SGaaS）的补救方案——一种连续、对抗性、由委托人主导的治理职能，通过红队协议、风险模拟和事前检验诊断等方法来弥补现行治理模型的空白。
AI.research_question: 为什么在治理投入持续增长的情况下，治理失败的频率和严重程度仍在上升？这种"治理悖论"的可识别原因是什么，以及存在什么样的结构性补救方案？
AI.motivation: 全球治理支出每年增长超过13%，但重大治理失败案例（波音、Wirecard、硅谷银行、瑞士信贷、邮局）证明现有的五层治理机制（董事会、审计委员会、内部审计、外部审计师、监管机构）即使全部到位仍然全部失效，这一矛盾亟需解释和解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理悖论理论；有限理性理论（bounded rationality）；决策噪声理论（Kahneman、Sibony和Sunstein）；三道防线模型（Three Lines Model）；委托-代理理论；价值保全框架
AI.method: 五个扩展案例研究（波音、Wirecard、硅谷银行、瑞士信贷、邮局）；实证分析669家德国、奥地利和瑞士上市公司（2018-2024）的数据；英欧美监管趋同分析（英国公司治理准则第29条、SMCR、DORA、CSDDD、特拉华州Caremark判例）
AI.findings: 1）战略与外部风险驱动了超过80%的严重危机事件，可预防的内部风险仅占19.2%；2）受影响公司在24个月后恢复至危机前价值的约103%，而基准指数达到115%，存在约12个百分点的持续性恢复缺口；3）32%的公司在2018-2024年间至少遭受过一次严重危机；4）内部审计将75%的能力分配给常规保证工作，73%的二线风险职能面临新兴风险识别的资金限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次命名并系统阐述"治理悖论"这一概念；将决策噪声理论引入公司治理缺陷的分析框架；提出治理投资应重新定位为价值保全而非成本；提出SGaaS作为三道防线模型的补充而非替代，填补了"授权与交付能力之间的价值缺口"这一理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"战略治理即服务"（SGaaS）的可操作架构，包括红队协议、风险模拟和事前检验诊断的方法论，以及从诊断到退出前介入的四层交付架构；为董事会层面保留连续、对抗性的治理职能提供具体实施方案；为监管趋同（英国、欧盟、美国）背景下企业如何建立监管无法提供的监督能力提供实践指引。

title:
The Audited Reserve
The Interceptor Stock the United States Declines to Govern by Rule is now
Counted, Nightly and by Results, by the State Firing at it

detail.title:
The Audited Reserve
The Interceptor Stock the United States Declines to Govern by Rule is now
Counted, Nightly and by Results, by the State Firing at it

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial conflicts of interest relevant to this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper does not involve human participants, patient data, or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research. This research was self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract:
The United States allocates its scarcest defensive munition, the ballistic-missile interceptor, by executive discretion, with no legal rule ranking the claims of Taiwan, Israel, and Ukraine against a finite stock. This paper documents the strategic consequence of that legal silence: the stock has acquired an auditor. Active missile defense publishes its own results; every engagement over Kyiv discloses, within hours, what was intercepted, what was not, and, by implication, what remains.

Open-source evidence from July 2026 shows Russian strike packages shrinking their ballistic component as Ukrainian interception collapsed toward zero, and strike tempo compressing around the defender's resupply rhythm rather than the attacker's production constraint, a pattern the paper weighs against its rival explanations and finds best explained as adaptation to a stock made legible by its own performance. The paper names this condition the Audited Reserve, traces its mechanism, tests it against the July strikes, and states what it demands of disclosure policy, firing doctrine, and allocation law.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国弹道导弹拦截弹这一稀缺防御弹药在行政裁量分配下的战略后果：由于缺乏法律规则来排序台湾、以色列、乌克兰的索求，导弹防御系统自身的公开表现成为库存的"审计者"。通过公开源情报，论文发现俄罗斯在2026年7月的打击模式（缩减弹道导弹成分、围绕防御方补给节奏压缩打击节奏）是对这种"被审计的储备"状态的适应性回应，并据此提出对披露政策、发射条令和分配法律的要求。
AI.research_question: 美国弹道导弹拦截弹的行政裁量分配（缺乏法律排序规则）如何产生战略性后果？具体而言，导弹防御系统公开的性能表现如何将稀缺库存"透明化"，进而影响攻击方行为与战略格局？
AI.motivation: 美国将最稀缺的防御性弹药——弹道导弹拦截弹——通过行政裁量分配，却没有法律规则对台湾、以色列、乌克兰的诉求进行排序。这种法律上的沉默产生了未被充分认识的战略后果：库存因自身表现而被"审计"（透明化），攻击方可以据此适应和调整打击策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出了"被审计的储备"（Audited Reserve）这一概念框架，解释导弹防御系统的公开表现如何将库存信息泄露给对手，形成一种新的战略信息状态。
AI.method: 采用公开源情报（open-source evidence）分析，聚焦2026年7月俄罗斯对乌克兰的打击数据，将观察到的打击模式（缩减弹道导弹成分、围绕防御方补给节奏压缩打击频率）与竞争性解释进行对比检验。
AI.findings: 2026年7月的开源证据显示：俄罗斯打击包中弹道导弹成分收缩，乌克兰拦截率趋近于零；打击节奏围绕防御方的补给节奏而非攻击方的生产约束进行压缩。经与竞争性解释对比，这一模式最合理的解释是：攻击方适应了因自身防御表现而被"审计"（透明化）的拦截弹库存。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并论证了"被审计的储备"（Audited Reserve）这一新的理论概念，揭示防御系统的性能公开如何成为一种非自愿的信息泄露机制，改变了攻防双方的信息不对称格局，并对既有分配法律理论提出新的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国在披露政策、发射条令和弹药分配法律方面的改革提供了具体依据：说明在缺乏法律排序的情况下，行政裁量分配如何产生战略脆弱性，并为政策制定者提出调整方向。

title: NP-Hardness of Unconstrained Assortment Optimization under the Exponomial Choice Model

detail.title: NP-Hardness of Unconstrained Assortment Optimization under the Exponomial Choice Model
detail.abstract: The computational complexity of unconstrained assortment optimization under the exponomial choice model is an open question. We resolve this question by proving that both the revenue-threshold decision problem and exact optimization are NP-hard via a polynomial-time reduction from Equipartition. The result holds for rational ideal utilities, nonnegative rational revenues, and a rational threshold, even when the mandatory no-purchase alternative has strictly lower ideal utility than every product.

AI.tldr: 本文通过从Equipartition问题的多项式时间归约，证明了在exponomial选择模型下，无约束品类优化问题的收入阈值决策问题和精确优化问题均为NP-hard，解决了该领域的开放性问题。
AI.research_question: 在exponomial选择模型下，无约束品类优化问题的计算复杂度是什么？即收入阈值决策问题和精确优化问题是否可以在多项式时间内求解？
AI.motivation: 无约束品类优化在exponomial选择模型下的计算复杂度此前是一个开放性问题，而该选择模型在实际零售场景中具有重要应用，明确其复杂度下限对于理论研究和算法设计都至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计算复杂度理论，NP-hardness归约，exponomial选择模型
AI.method: 通过从Equipartition问题（等分问题）构造多项式时间归约，证明exponomial选择模型下的收入阈值决策问题与精确优化问题均为NP-hard。
AI.findings: 即使在理性理想效用、非负理性收入、理性阈值，且强制无购买选项的理想效用严格低于所有产品等条件下，收入阈值决策问题和精确优化问题仍然是NP-hard的。
AI.theory_contributions: 解决了exponomial选择模型下无约束品类优化的计算复杂度这一开放问题，为该模型下的优化问题建立了明确的计算复杂度下限，补充了品类优化领域的复杂度理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 明确了在exponomial选择模型下求解最优品类的计算难度，为从业者选择合适的近似算法或启发式算法提供了理论依据，避免对精确求解的不切实际期待。

title: The Impact of Institutional Openness on Export Activities of Firms in China's Digital Service Sector
affiliations: Zhongnan University of Economics and Law

detail.title: The Impact of Institutional Openness on Export Activities of Firms in China's Digital Service Sector
detail.abstract:
This study examines the impact of institutional openness on the export activities of firms in China's digital
service industry over the period 2015–2022. Adapting the Melitz (2003) model of heterogeneous firms, we
develop a partial-equilibrium export decision model in which institutional openness affects firm productivity,
the business environment, and the probability that foreign importers honor their contractual commitments. The
model predicts that institutional openness and firm export experience each raise export volumes, but that the two
act as substitutes: because both operate by reducing a firm's exposure to opportunistic trading partners, the
marginal contribution of institutional openness declines as export experience accumulates. We test these
predictions using a panel of A-share listed digital service firms, with institutional openness measured by a
bilateral index constructed from the OECD Digital Services Trade Restrictiveness Index. Institutional openness
is associated with significantly higher export volumes, and the estimated interaction between openness and
export experience is negative, as the model implies. The response is strongest among small and young firms and
is statistically indistinguishable from zero among mature firms; firms of all three ownership types respond
positively. The sign pattern is preserved under Tobit and PPML estimation and for two- and three-period lags of
institutional openness. Because institutional openness varies only at the national-annual level, we interpret the
estimates as conditional associations rather than causal effects. These results characterize a period of regulator convergence in digitally delivered services, and we discuss why they should not be extrapolated to the post-
2022 environment.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Melitz（2003）异质性企业模型，研究2015-2022年间制度开放度对中国数字服务企业出口活动的影响。研究发现制度开放度显著提升企业出口规模，且与出口经验呈替代关系，该效应在小企业和年轻企业中最为显著。
AI.research_question: 制度开放度如何影响中国数字服务企业的出口活动？制度开放度与企业出口经验之间是何种关系？
AI.motivation: 数字服务贸易日益重要，但关于制度开放度（如数字服务贸易限制）对企业出口行为的影响缺乏深入研究，尤其是制度开放度与出口经验之间的交互机制尚未被充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Melitz（2003）异质性企业贸易模型，构建部分均衡出口决策模型，将制度开放度纳入影响企业生产率、商业环境以及外国进口商履约概率的分析框架。
AI.method: 使用2015-2022年中国A股上市数字服务企业面板数据，以OECD数字服务贸易限制指数构建双边制度开放度指标，采用面板回归（含Tobit和PPML估计）进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 制度开放度与企业出口显著正相关；制度开放度与出口经验的交互项为负，二者呈替代关系；该效应在小企业和年轻企业中最为显著，成熟企业中统计上不显著；三种所有制类型的企业均呈正向响应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度开放度纳入异质性企业贸易模型，提出制度开放度与出口经验通过降低机会主义交易对手风险暴露发挥替代作用的理论机制，丰富了制度因素与企业出口决策的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解数字服务贸易开放政策的边际效益递减规律提供依据，提示政策设计需考虑企业异质性；同时指出2022年后监管环境变化使得结果不可简单外推，为未来政策评估提供参考。

title: AI by Africa, for Africa: Mobilising African Capital for Digital Sovereignty

detail.title: AI by Africa, for Africa: Mobilising African Capital for Digital Sovereignty
detail.abstract: Economic gaps between countries in the Global North and Africa characterise sovereign Artificial Intelligence development as a resource problem. This tension exposes the continent to dynamics that exceed old dependencies, reaching farther to reframe key and sometimes immutable aspects of social life, wellbeing, business and identity in extrapolations based on foreign data. The parallel impact of this trend is failure to capture the exponential economic benefits that Artificial Intelligence development represents for the regional economy. Given the prevalence of low and prohibitive capital allocation to Africa, despite its significant share of the global population, the paper makes a case for the mobilisation of local financial alternatives for the realisation of its AI ambitions. It further argues for the adoption of industrial clusters as effective strategies for derisking investment, pooling resources and catalysing growth.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了全球北方国家与非洲之间的经济差距如何将主权人工智能发展框定为资源问题，主张非洲应动员本地金融替代方案，并采用产业集群策略来降低投资风险、整合资源和促进增长，以实现其AI发展雄心和区域经济利益。
AI.research_question: 非洲如何在资源受限和资本配置不足的条件下，实现主权人工智能发展并获取其区域经济收益？
AI.motivation: 全球北方与非洲之间的经济差距使非洲的人工智能发展面临资源困境，不仅使其暴露于超越旧有依附关系的外部动态中，还导致其无法获取AI发展带来的指数级经济效益。鉴于非洲占全球人口的显著比例却获得极低的资本配置，亟需探索本地化的融资与增长策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权AI发展理论；依附理论（经济差距与南北关系）；产业集群理论
AI.method: 本文为论证性/概念性论文，通过分析非洲面临的资本配置困境，提出动员本地金融替代方案和采用产业集群策略的论点。
AI.findings: 非洲因资本配置过低而无法捕获AI发展带来的指数级经济收益；需要动员本地金融替代方案来支持AI发展；产业集群是降低投资风险、整合资源和催化增长的有效策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 将主权AI发展重新框定为资源问题，并将产业集群理论引入非洲AI发展战略，拓展了对全球南方国家AI发展路径的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲决策者提供了动员本地资本和采用产业集群策略以推动AI发展的实践建议，有助于降低投资风险并催化区域经济增长。

title: The Innovation Radar 2.0 A Framework for Measuring and Diagnosing Business Innovation

detail.title: The Innovation Radar 2.0 A Framework for Measuring and Diagnosing Business Innovation
detail.abstract: Innovation sits at the top of the agenda for all CEOs. Yet most firms cannot say where they innovate, whether that pattern serves their strategy, or how far practice has drifted from intent. This paper presents the Innovation Radar 2.0, a framework for mapping, diagnosing, and prescribing innovation strategy. It descends from the original Innovation Radar (Sawhney, Wolcott, and Arroniz 2006), which mapped twelve dimensions of business innovation, and extends it in two ways. Beneath the dimensions sits a substrate of purpose, culture, and leadership, rated green, yellow, or red, that gates the returns on everything above it. Above them sits a ground truth: the firm's stated strategy is translated into a target innovation profile, the actual profile is measured against it, and the distance between the two is read as innovation strategy drift. The result is a complete innovation control system. It makes the ground truth financial as well as strategic, testing whether the innovation budget is consistent with the growth ambition before any diagnosis is issued. It translates prescriptions into profit-and-loss terms through innovation elasticity, the rate at which improvement on a dimension converts into financial results. It adds a generative stage that produces a portfolio of fifteen to twenty scored innovation plays, screened against the strategy. And it introduces an evidence protocol that makes scores drawn from public information auditable from the citations they carry. Three case studies show the framework in action: an end-to-end worked example for a synthetic company, an application to Zebra Technologies, and a comparative reading of Anthropic and OpenAI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了创新雷达2.0（Innovation Radar 2.0），一个用于绘制、诊断和制定创新战略的完整框架。它在原有12维度创新雷达的基础上，增加了目的、文化与领导力的底层基座，以及将公司战略转化为目标创新画像、测量实际画像并计算两者差距的创新战略漂移检测。该框架形成一个完整的创新控制系统，包含财务基准检验、创新弹性量化、生成式方案组合和基于引用的证据协议。三个案例展示了其应用。
AI.research_question: 企业如何系统地绘制其创新布局、诊断创新实践与战略意图之间的偏差，并据此制定可执行的创新战略处方？
AI.motivation: 大多数CEO将创新列为最高优先级，但多数企业无法回答自己在哪里创新、创新模式是否匹配战略、实践与意图之间偏离了多远。现有框架缺乏对创新战略的系统性诊断和处方能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于创新雷达（Innovation Radar）的12维度业务创新框架，融合战略对齐理论、创新战略漂移概念、创新弹性（innovation elasticity）概念，以及创新控制系统理论。
AI.method: 框架开发与案例研究法，包括一个合成公司的端到端完整示例、对Zebra Technologies的应用分析，以及对Anthropic和OpenAI的比较分析。采用基于引用的证据协议确保评分可审计。
AI.findings: 创新雷达2.0能够将公司战略转化为可测量的目标创新画像，量化战略漂移程度，通过创新弹性将处方转化为财务术语，生成15-20个经过筛选的创新方案组合，并使分数来源可审计。三个案例展示了框架的实际操作价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了创新战略漂移（innovation strategy drift）的概念化操作方法，将创新弹性引入创新管理理论，构建了包含底层基座、创新维度和战略顶层目标的完整创新控制框架，推动创新管理从描述性迈向诊断与处方性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了完整的创新控制系统：可通过财务基准检验创新预算与增长野心的匹配度，通过创新弹性将改进转化为损益影响，生成可执行的评分创新方案组合，并确保所有评分基于可审计的公开信息，帮助企业关闭战略与实践之间的差距。

title: Where Do Tariff Shocks Propagate? Evidence on Production, Prices, and Shipments from Section 301 China Tariffs

detail.title: Where Do Tariff Shocks Propagate? Evidence on Production, Prices, and Shipments from Section 301 China Tariffs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No external funding was received for this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses only publicly available, aggregate industry-level data and does not involve human participants, human data, or identifiable personal information. Ethical approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract:
Section 301 China tariffs matter because they represent a major recent intervention in U.S. manufacturing trade policy, with potential implications for domestic production, prices, and shipments. According to textbook trade theory, tariffs are intended to support the domestic economy by raising the relative cost of foreign goods and services, thereby protecting import-competing domestic producers from foreign competition. This paper uses the 2018–2019 Section 301 tariffs on Chinese imports as a source of exogenous variation to estimate the effects of these tariffs on production, prices, and shipments in the U.S. economy. The paper uses a triple-difference design at the NAICS-4 level, with world import penetration as the control dimension, and analyzes three outcome panels: BLS-PPI, FRED-IP, and Census-M3. The estimation using the FRED-IP panel indicates that tariff exposure reduced manufacturing activity: β = −0.783 and boot-p = 0.005, with an attenuation ratio of 1.016. Practically, at the mean exposure level among treated industries, the estimated effect corresponds to an approximate 17.7 percent reduction in industrial production after the tariff shock (see Appendix A7).

Methodologically, I use a three-difference-in-differences approach to compare high-exposure versus low-exposure industries before and after the tariff shocks; the third difference corresponds to the level of penetration of non-Chinese goods to account for pre-trends across a family of commodities. When the effect of tariffs on prices was examined, the results indicated a positive but imprecise effect, which may reflect insufficient variation at the industry level; nevertheless, the clustered standard errors detected a statistically significant relationship, though this relationship became imprecise under bootstrap inference. In the primary specification, Census-M3 shows a negative effect on nominal shipments (attenuation ratio of −0.961), although this estimate is imprecisely estimated.

The paper contributes evidence on how tariff shocks propagate across production, prices, and shipments within manufacturing industries. In doing so, it complements research on the price and welfare incidence of the 2018–2019 tariffs by adding production-side evidence at the NAICS-4 level, contributes to the broader literature on how tariff and import-competition shocks propagate through domestic manufacturing, and offers a triple-difference design with a continuous world-import-penetration control as an alternative to more conventional binary treatment definitions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2018-2019年美国对华Section 301关税作为外生冲击，采用三重差分设计（以世界进口渗透率作为控制维度），在NAICS-4行业层面估计关税对美国制造业生产、价格和出货量的影响。研究发现关税暴露显著降低了工业产出（FRED-IP面板：β=-0.783，处理行业平均降低约17.7%），价格效应为正但不精确，名义出货量效应为负但不精确。
AI.research_question: 2018-2019年美国对华Section 301关税对美国制造业的生产、价格和出货量有何影响？
AI.motivation: Section 301关税是近年来美国制造业贸易政策的重大干预，可能对国内生产、价格和出货量产生重要影响。虽然已有研究关注关税的价格和福利效应，但缺乏生产侧（production-side）的行业层面证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教科书贸易理论：关税通过提高外国商品的相对成本来保护进口竞争型国内生产者，从而支持国内经济。
AI.method: 三重差分设计（triple-difference）：在NAICS-4层面比较高暴露与低暴露行业在关税冲击前后的差异，第三个差异为非中国商品进口渗透率水平；分析三个结果面板：BLS-PPI（价格）、FRED-IP（工业生产）、Census-M3（出货量），并使用聚类标准误和bootstrap推断。
AI.findings: （1）关税暴露显著降低了制造业活动：FRED-IP面板β=-0.783，bootstrap p=0.005，衰减比为1.016；在平均暴露水平下对应约17.7%的工业产出下降。（2）价格效应为正但不精确，聚类标准误下显著，但bootstrap推断下不精确。（3）Census-M3显示名义出货量有负效应（衰减比-0.961），但估计不精确。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）补充了2018-2019关税价格和福利效应研究，增加了NAICS-4层面的生产侧证据；（2）为关税和进口竞争冲击如何通过国内制造业传导的文献做出贡献；（3）提出以连续世界进口渗透率作为控制变量的三重差分设计，作为传统二元处理定义的替代方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估关税政策对国内制造业产出的实际影响提供了量化证据，表明Section 301关税确实显著抑制了受暴露行业的工业生产。

title: Industrial Subsidies and Global Market Shares: A First Principles Analysis

detail.title: Industrial Subsidies and Global Market Shares: A First Principles Analysis
detail.abstract: Industrial subsidies have returned to the centre of international economic policy debates following publication of results based on the OECD's MAGIC database that subsidies accounted for a substantial share of manufacturing firm's market-share gains over the period 2005-2023, particularly those of Chinese firms. Taking the OECD's subsidy estimates as given, this paper reconsiders their economic significance from first principles. In line with the OECD's observation that the impact of subsidies flows through firms' effective weighted average cost of capital (WACC) to increased investment, the paper translates the subsidies expressed as a share of revenue, as presented by the OECD, into equivalent reductions in financing costs. Applying representative financial data for the United States, Europe and China, the paper shows that the implied reductions in country-average WACCs, while economically meaningful, remain modest relative to the dispersion of financing costs observed across industries and still leave China with a higher average cost of capital. The paper further observes that gross subsidies cannot be interpreted independently of taxation and other fiscal transfers (what matters is the un-measured net fiscal transfer), distinguishes reductions in WACC from reductions in investment hurdle rates in driving investment, and highlights the functional equivalence of "soft budget constraints" faced by state-owned enterprises with the weak conditionality on profits when private capital is supported by deep capital markets and "plutocratic capital". Finally, it argues that Lerner symmetry cautions against interpreting export market-share gains as deriving from subsidies without accounting for corresponding effects of subsidies on imports. As a bottom line, the paper argues that the OECD's non-findings of any meaningful impact of subsidies on firm investment rates, productivity or profitability undermine its conclusion that subsidies nonetheless had a massive impact on firms' market shares; and advances the conjecture that the market share gains of Chinese firms were explained principally by the expansion of China's economy and that the role of the state ran not through subsidies that reduced the WACC but through the reduction in the hurdle rate of investment, which enabled the rapid modernization of China's economy by substituting the socially optimal hurdle rate for the much higher private rate. The paper draws conclusions for the conduct of industrial policy by small open economies.

AI.tldr: 本文以OECD的MAGIC数据库补贴估算为前提，从第一性原理重新审视产业补贴的经济意义，认为补贴对WACC的降低幅度相对行业融资成本离散度而言仍然温和，且中国平均资本成本仍更高；文章区分了WACC降低与投资门槛率降低的不同作用，并质疑补贴是导致中国企业在全球市场份额上升的主要原因，提出中国市场份额增长主要源于经济扩张和国家通过降低投资门槛率而非补贴发挥作用的猜想。
AI.research_question: OECD基于MAGIC数据库估算的产业补贴（尤其是中国企业获得的补贴）对企业市场份额增长的所谓"巨大影响"在经济学上是否成立？补贴的经济意义应如何从第一性原理重新评估？
AI.motivation: OECD的补贴估算结果引发了对产业补贴在国际经济政策中的广泛讨论，但该结果的经济意义尚未被严格审视。作者希望从WACC、净财政转移、软预算约束、勒纳对称性等角度重新考量补贴的真实影响，挑战OECD的结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 加权平均资本成本（WACC）理论、净财政转移概念、软预算约束理论、勒纳对称性（Lerner Symmetry）、投资门槛率（hurdle rate）理论
AI.method: 基于OECD补贴估算数据，将补贴占收入的比重转换为融资成本的等效降低，并运用美国、欧洲和中国具有代表性的财务数据进行计算比较分析；同时进行概念性推理和理论论证。
AI.findings: （1）补贴隐含的国家平均WACC降低虽有经济意义，但相对于行业间融资成本的离散度仍然温和，且中国平均资本成本仍高于美国与欧洲；（2）毛补贴不能脱离税收及其他财政转移独立理解，重要的是未测量的净财政转移；（3）WACC降低与投资门槛率降低在驱动投资中的作用不同；（4）国有企业的"软预算约束"与由深度资本市场和"富豪资本"支持的私人资本的弱利润条件性在功能上等价；（5）勒纳对称性提醒，解释出口市场份额增长不能忽视补贴对进口的对应影响；（6）OECD未发现补贴对企业投资率、生产率或盈利能力的显著影响，与其"补贴对市场份额有巨大影响"的结论自相矛盾；（7）中国市场份额增长主要源于经济扩张，国家的作用在于降低投资门槛率而非通过补贴降低WACC。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）从第一性原理重新评估了补贴对WACC的经济意义，提供了将补贴收入份额转换为融资成本等效降低的分析框架；（2）区分了WACC降低与投资门槛率降低在投资驱动机制上的差异；（3）揭示了软预算约束与弱利润条件性在功能上的等价性；（4）将勒纳对称性应用于补贴与市场份额关系的分析；（5）提出国家通过降低投资门槛率而非补贴来促进经济发展的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为小型开放经济体的产业政策制定提供了启示；（2）警示政策制定者在解读补贴数据时需考虑税收和其他财政转移的净效应；（3）帮助学术界与政策界更审慎地解读OECD补贴估算结果及其政策含义。

title: From Transmission Loss to Transmission Immunity: How Organizational Joints Reject or Defend Intent
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: From Transmission Loss to Transmission Immunity: How Organizational Joints Reject or Defend Intent
detail.abstract: Organizational intent frequently fails to translate into practice not merely due to signal attenuation during transmission, but active resistance. This paper introduces the construct of “transmission immunity” to capture mechanisms whereby organizational joints selectively filter, block or resist signals conflicting with incumbents‘ interests or value orientations. Building upon the Organizational Skeleton Framework, we argue that transmission immunity is inherently dual-sided. When joints are occupied by self-interested actors, malignant immunity emerges, repudiating official organizational intent and accelerating structural rigidity. When occupied by actors with strong organizational identification, benign immunity arises, enabling resistance to flawed top-down directives and safeguarding core organizational functions. Drawing on comparative case analyses of labour unions (CFMEU, PSA) and corporations (Toshiba, Enron), this article identifies triggering conditions, operational mechanisms and organizational outcomes of transmission immunity. Our analysis suggests that a functional organizational skeleton relies not only on formal structural design, but also on value alignment and feedback mechanisms embedded within its transmission joints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"传输免疫"（transmission immunity）这一新构念，用以解释组织意图在传导过程中因关节处行动者主动抵抗而无法落地的现象。通过对工会（CFMEU、PSA）和公司（东芝、安然）的比较案例分析，识别了传输免疫的触发条件、运作机制与组织后果，并区分了恶性免疫与良性免疫两种面向。
AI.research_question: 组织意图为何无法转化为实践？组织关节处如何选择性地过滤、阻断或抵抗与在位者利益或价值观冲突的信号？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注信号在传输过程中的衰减，但忽略了组织内部行动者的主动抵抗。组织意图无法落实不仅是因为信息失真，更是因为关节处的选择性阻挠，这需要新的理论构念来解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织骨架框架（Organizational Skeleton Framework）
AI.method: 比较案例分析法（comparative case analyses），涵盖两家工会（CFMEU、PSA）与两家公司（东芝、安然）的案例。
AI.findings: 传输免疫具有双重面向：当关节由自利行动者占据时，产生恶性免疫，拒绝官方组织意图并加速结构僵化；当关节由强组织认同的行动者占据时，产生良性免疫，能够抵抗有缺陷的上级指令并保护核心组织功能。功能性组织骨架不仅依赖正式结构设计，还依赖嵌入在传输关节中的价值观对齐与反馈机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入"传输免疫"新构念，拓展了组织骨架框架，将组织传导失败的原因从被动的信号衰减扩展到主动的信号抵抗，并识别了免疫的二元性（良性/恶性）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计提供启示：管理者需关注传输关节处的价值对齐与反馈机制建设，以促进良性免疫、抑制恶性免疫，确保组织意图的有效传导与落地。

title: Electoral Rules and Regional Representation in a Japanese Academic Society: A Web-archive Reconstruction of Governance Layers, 2012-2026
affiliations: Nanzan University

detail.title: Electoral Rules and Regional Representation in a Japanese Academic Society: A Web-archive Reconstruction of Governance Layers, 2012-2026

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a member of the society examined here; he has never held any office in it and had no role in the selection of any body analysed. The author serves on the editorial boards of two academic journals and as a director of a Japanese academic society other than the one examined here. None of these roles bears on the subject of this report.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study involves no human participants. It analyses publicly available organisational records only.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Academic societies distribute a consequential resource-seats on the bodies that govern a discipline-yet the historical composition of those bodies is rarely published, and longitudinal study has been correspondingly rare. This report reconstructs fourteen years of governance composition for a Japanese social-science society from public web archives, recovering eight consecutive terms (2012-2026) across every published layer, and reads that reconstruction against the society's articles of incorporation and electoral regulations. The society selects its governing bodies by election: members elect a body of delegates under a parallel system in which half the seats are apportioned across six districts in proportion to membership, and those delegates in turn elect the directors. The regulations, however, apportion the franchise and not eligibility. Every regular member is eligible for the directorate, and in each post-incorporation term between a quarter and a third of directors held no delegate seat. Regional diversity is accordingly stable at the base layer (Simpson's index 0.742 in 2012, 0.753 in the current term) but falls to 0.172 at the directorate and to 0.000 across the full published succession of presidents, every one of whom has been affiliated with an institution in a single district. The fall occurs at the layer at which the regional apportionment device ceases to apply.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过公共网络档案重建了日本某社会科学学会2012-2026年八个任期的治理结构数据，分析了代表选举制度对地区多样性的影响。研究发现该学会采用并行选举制（代表按会员数在六个地区分配，代表再选举理事），但选举权分配仅适用于代表层而非理事层。地区多样性在代表层保持稳定（Simpson指数约0.74-0.75），但在理事层骤降至0.172，而全部历任会长均来自单一地区（多样性指数为0.000），表明区域性分配机制失效的层级正是多样性急剧下降之处。
AI.research_question: 学术社团治理机构的地区多样性如何随选举层级变化？区域分配机制在设计失效的层级上是否会导致多样性崩溃？
AI.motivation: 学术社团治理机构的构成数据极少公开发布，长期纵向研究稀缺。本文利用公共网络档案填补这一空白，并通过比较不同治理层级（代表、理事、会长）的地区多样性，检验选举制度设计对治理代表性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选举制度设计理论；代表性/多样性理论；联邦制式的区域配额分配理论（并行选举制下的区域代表机制）
AI.method: 从公共网络档案中重建日本社会科学学会2012-2026年八个连续任期的全部治理层（代表、理事、会长）组成数据；结合该学会章程与选举规则进行制度分析；使用Simpson多样性指数量化各治理层的地区多样性。
AI.findings: (1) 代表层地区多样性稳定（Simpson指数2012年为0.742，现任期为0.753）；(2) 理事层地区多样性骤降至0.172；(3) 全部历任会长均来自单一地区（多样性指数为0.000）；(4) 每届理事中有1/4至1/3未持有代表席位；(5) 多样性陡降恰好发生在区域分配机制停止适用的层级。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了制度设计中"分配选举权而非当选资格"这一设计选择对治理代表性的影响机制，表明区域配额机制只有在明确适用到整个治理链条时才有效，为选举制度设计与组织多样性研究提供了纵向实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术社团等组织提供治理改革建议：若追求地区多样性，仅对基层代表实施区域配额不足以保证高层治理的多元性；对学术社团治理透明化与数据公开提供了示范性的研究方法。

title: Rising Inflation in India: Causes, Consequences and Policy Pathways -A Contemporary Review
affiliations: Awadhesh Pratap Singh University and  Government Thakur Ranmat Singh Autonomous College

detail.title: Rising Inflation in India: Causes, Consequences and Policy Pathways -A Contemporary Review
detail.abstract: Inflation has re-emerged as the central macroeconomic concern for Indian policymakers in 2026. Retail price inflation, as measured by the Consumer Price Index (CPI), climbed steadily from historic lows recorded in mid-2025 to 4.38 per cent by June 2026, while wholesale price inflation, measured by the Wholesale Price Index (WPI), crossed 9.8 percent in the same month, the widest wholesaleretail divergence witnessed in several years. This review article examines the recent trajectory of inflation in India against the backdrop of the major theoretical traditions in the economics of inflation classical monetarism, Keynesian demand-management theory, cost-push and structuralist analysis, and the expectations-augmented Phillips Curveand situates the current episode within the specific conjuncture of a West Asian geopolitical shock, crude-oil price volatility, rupee depreciation and an uneven southwest monsoon. Drawing on official statistics released by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI), the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, together with the published views of economists such as Raghuram Rajan and C. Rangarajan and the assessments of contemporary market economists, the article develops a comparative analysis of the causes, transmission channels and distributional consequences of the present inflationary episode, paying particular attention to its disproportionate burden on rural and low-income households. The review concludes with a synthesis of monetary, fiscal and supply-side policy recommendationsincluding calibrated repo-rate management, buffer-stock and agriculturalmarket reform, strategic energy reserves, exchange-rate stabilisation and targeted social protectionintended to restore price stability without unduly sacrificing India's underlying growth momentum. The analysis contributes to the ongoing academic and policy debate on inflation management in large emerging economies confronting simultaneous external shocks and structural rigidities.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了2026年印度通胀的近期轨迹，将其置于古典货币主义、凯恩斯需求管理、成本推动与结构主义分析以及预期增广菲利普斯曲线等主要经济学理论传统的背景下，结合西亚地缘政治冲击、原油价格波动、卢比贬值和西南季风不稳定等具体形势，运用官方统计数据和经济学家观点，对当前通胀的成因、传导渠道和分配后果进行比较分析，并提出货币、财政和供给侧的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 在2026年印度面临外部冲击与结构性刚性的背景下，当前通胀的成因、传导渠道和分配后果是什么？应该如何制定兼顾价格稳定与增长动力的政策组合？
AI.motivation: 2026年印度通胀重新成为宏观经济政策的核心关切，CPI从2025年中期历史低点攀升至4.38%，WPI突破9.8%，批发与零售通胀出现多年罕见的最大背离，亟需从理论和政策层面系统审视这一通胀态势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 古典货币主义、凯恩斯需求管理理论、成本推动与结构主义分析、预期增广菲利普斯曲线
AI.method: 基于MoSPI、RBI和工商部官方统计数据的比较分析，结合Raghuram Rajan和C. Rangarajan等经济学家及当代市场经济学家的观点，对通胀成因、传导渠道和分配后果进行综合评述。
AI.findings: 当前印度通胀源于西亚地缘政治冲击、原油价格波动、卢比贬值和不均匀西南季风等多重外部冲击与结构性刚性的叠加；通胀对农村和低收入家庭造成不成比例的负担；批发与零售通胀存在显著背离。
AI.theory_contributions: 将多重通胀理论传统整合运用于大型新兴经济体面临外部冲击与结构刚性的具体实践情境，丰富了通胀管理理论在新兴经济体中的适用性讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出涵盖货币政策（校准回购利率）、财政政策、供给侧改革（缓冲库存与农产品市场改革、战略能源储备、汇率稳定）以及定向社会保护的综合性政策建议，旨在恢复价格稳定的同时不损害印度经济增长动力。

title: Identifying Inventory Policies from Digital Traces: A Data-driven Approach using Real-World Order Patterns
affiliations: Kuehne Logistics University and Kuehne Logistics University

detail.title: Identifying Inventory Policies from Digital Traces: A Data-driven Approach using Real-World Order Patterns
detail.abstract: Understanding how inventory policies are implemented in practice remains a fundamental challenge in operations management because replenishment rules are rarely shared with others. However, different inventory policies leave identifiable signatures in transactional order data, creating an opportunity to infer otherwise hidden replenishment structures. This study develops a two-stage data-driven framework for identifying inventory policies directly from observed order behavior. In the first stage, semi-synthetic data, machine-learning classification, and expert evaluation are used to develop and validate a robust policy-identification model. In the second stage, the selected model is applied to a large-scale order dataset provided by a global travel-retail wholesaler, comprising 128,834 order time series across a diverse set of retailers and product categories. The results reveal only partial alignment between observed replenishment behavior and classical inventory-theory expectations. While policy selection varies systematically with product characteristics, substantial heterogeneity exists across retailers, and identical products are frequently managed using different replenishment rules. Retailer-level factors explain more variation in inferred policy behavior than product characteristics alone, highlighting the importance of organizational context in inventory-policy implementation. The study contributes a scalable methodology for inventory-policy identification and provides large-scale empirical evidence on how inventory policies are implemented in practice. More broadly, it demonstrates how the digital traces embedded in transactional order data can be used to uncover otherwise unobservable operational decision structures.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个两阶段数据驱动框架，通过交易订单数据推断零售商的库存补货政策。第一阶段利用半合成数据、机器学习和专家评估构建并验证政策识别模型；第二阶段将该模型应用于全球旅游零售批发商提供的128,834条订单时间序列数据，发现实际补货行为与经典库存理论仅有部分吻合，零售商层面的组织因素比产品特征更能解释政策差异。
AI.research_question: 如何从交易订单数据中识别库存政策？实际中的库存政策实施与经典库存理论预期有何差异？哪些因素（产品特征vs零售商层面因素）更能解释库存政策的选择差异？
AI.motivation: 库存政策在实践中如何实施是运营管理领域的根本性挑战，因为补货规则很少被外部共享，研究者难以直接观察企业的库存决策结构，需要开发新的方法从可观察数据中推断不可观察的运营决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典库存理论（补货策略选择和产品特征之间的系统关系）；组织情境理论（零售商层面的组织因素影响政策实施）；机器学习分类方法框架
AI.method: 两阶段数据驱动框架：第一阶段使用半合成数据训练机器学习分类模型，并结合专家评估进行验证；第二阶段将验证后的模型应用于大规模真实订单数据（128,834个订单时间序列），覆盖多样化的零售商和产品类别。
AI.findings: 1) 实际补货行为与经典库存理论预期只有部分吻合；2) 政策选择随产品特征系统变化，但零售商之间存在显著异质性；3) 相同产品经常被不同零售商采用不同补货规则管理；4) 零售商层面因素比产品特征能解释更多推断政策行为的差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了可扩展的库存政策识别方法论，能够从交易数据中推断隐藏的补货结构；2) 提供了大规模实证证据，丰富了库存政策实施的理论理解；3) 展示了如何利用交易订单数据中的数字足迹揭示不可观测的运营决策结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为运营管理者提供了一种无需内部数据即可识别竞争对手或合作伙伴库存政策的工具；2) 为批发商和零售商优化供应链协作提供了基于数据洞察的决策支持；3) 方法论可推广到其他依赖数字交易痕迹推断运营结构的场景。

title: Chinese Automotive Brands in Europe: The Infrastructure Donor Trap and the Semiotic Barrier to Premiumization

detail.title: Chinese Automotive Brands in Europe: The Infrastructure Donor Trap and the Semiotic Barrier to Premiumization

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests and no personal or institutional relationships that could have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it did not involve human participants, patients, animals, clinical intervention, or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper presents a two-level hypothesis concerning structural barriers to premiumization of Chinese automotive brands in the European market. The first level is market-operational: Chinese groups build dealer networks, service infrastructure, and category familiarity, lowering the psychological entry barrier. However, at technological parity the accumulated infrastructure is inherited by European brands with established symbolic capital. The key donated asset is the charging network: Chinese brands deploy fast-charging stations continent-wide, creating brand-neutral contact points that benefit all compatible vehicles. This mechanism is termed the infrastructure donor trap. The second level is semiotic: the visual identities of key Chinese brands carry preconscious associative risks through three channels — visual gestalt (BYD, Denza, Yangwang, NIO, ORA, GWM, XPeng, Zeekr, Geely), lexical priming (NIO, MG), and phonetic priming (Xiaomi). Analysis is conducted through detailed verbal descriptions of geometric structure; no visual materials are reproduced. Comparative analysis of Korean brands establishes an asymmetry: Korean brands entered Europe with low logo-level risks and strong lexical priming from model names. Chinese brands entered with the inverse configuration. The paper documents analogous risks in established brands (Lexus, SEAT) and explains why the same mechanism produces different outcomes depending on accumulated symbolic capital — the suppression buffer. A five-stage clinical screening protocol (Kartashov, 2026a) is proposed as a universal detection instrument absent from current industry practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个双层假说，解释中国汽车品牌在欧洲市场高端化面临的结构性障碍：第一层是市场运营层面的"基础设施捐赠者陷阱"——中国品牌投入巨资建设充电网络等基础设施，但在技术对等时，这些资产反而被具有象征资本的欧洲品牌所继承；第二层是符号学层面的品牌视觉识别风险——中国品牌在视觉形态、词汇启动和语音启动三个渠道存在前意识联想风险。通过与韩国品牌的对比分析，揭示了不同进入配置导致的差异化结果，并提出五阶段临床筛查方案作为检测工具。
AI.research_question: 中国汽车品牌在欧洲市场高端化过程中面临的结构性障碍是什么？这些障碍如何通过市场运营和符号学两个层面共同作用？
AI.motivation: 中国汽车品牌在欧洲市场面临高端化困境，现有研究多聚焦于技术、价格和品牌认知，但缺乏对结构性机制的系统性解释。本文试图从基础设施建设和符号学双重维度，解释为何中国品牌在技术与产品力进步的同时仍难以突破高端化天花板。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双层假说框架：1) 市场运营层面的"基础设施捐赠者陷阱"理论——基础设施投入在技术对等时被具有符号资本的既有品牌继承；2) 符号学层面的视觉/词汇/语音三重启动机制——品牌视觉识别中的前意识联想风险；3) "抑制缓冲"概念——象征资本积累如何缓冲品牌符号风险。
AI.method: 定性分析：通过详细的几何结构文字描述对品牌视觉识别进行分析（不复制视觉材料）；采用对比分析方法，将中国品牌与韩国品牌进入欧洲市场的初始配置进行不对称比较；同时对已建立品牌（雷克萨斯、西雅特）的类似风险进行文献性分析。
AI.findings: 1) 中国品牌在充电网络等基础设施上的投入形成了"基础设施捐赠者陷阱"，惠及所有兼容车辆而非仅自身品牌；2) 中国品牌视觉识别系统在视觉完形（比亚迪、蔚来等）、词汇启动（NIO、MG）和语音启动（小米）三个渠道存在前意识联想风险；3) 韩国品牌以低标志风险和强模型名词汇启动进入欧洲，与中国品牌形成镜像配置；4) 相同符号机制在不同象征资本积累下产生不同结果（抑制缓冲机制）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出"基础设施捐赠者陷阱"概念，将基础设施投资的外部性问题引入品牌国际化理论；构建了视觉-词汇-语音三重前意识联想分析框架；提出"抑制缓冲"概念解释象征资本对符号风险的调节作用；通过中韩品牌对比建立了不对称进入配置的分析范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出五阶段临床筛查方案（Kartashov, 2026a）作为行业通用的品牌符号风险检测工具，弥补当前行业实践中检测手段的缺失；为中国品牌进入欧洲市场的高端化策略提供结构性障碍的识别与规避指南。

title: The Dobbs Dissent Delay: Examining Allegations of Intentional Delay Amid Threats to the Justices

detail.title: The Dobbs Dissent Delay: Examining Allegations of Intentional Delay Amid Threats to the Justices
detail.abstract: After the leaked draft opinion in Dobbs, the Justices in the majority faced threats, harassment, and at least one assassination attempt. Yet the Court did not release its decision until 205 days after oral argument, more than twice the average length of time. In 2026, conservative journalist Mollie Hemingway made the explosive allegation that despite this danger to their colleagues, the dissenting Justices intentionally delayed releasing their dissent through a series of calculated postponements, and then by inserting a single footnote to a not-yet-published Supreme Court opinion, thus further delaying the decision in Dobbs. This Article examines numerous aspects of that claim. After documenting the Dobbs case and subsequent leak, it considers the scope of the threats against the Justices in the majority and the dismissive response by some politicians, journalists, and law enforcement—context essential to evaluating the delay allegation. Next, it presents Hemingway’s allegation. Then, it assesses the strengths and weaknesses of the claim, considering the timeline, a parallel controversy in Louisiana v. Callais, the uncorroborated, single-source nature of the claim and related potential for a politically motivated bias by Hemingway, the unprecedented nature and length of the majority opinion that the dissent was responding to, the relative significance of dissenting opinions, the necessity of a footnote that caused further delays, and Chief Justice Roberts’s unwillingness to release the majority opinion early—something he did in another case three years earlier. This Article concludes that, while no direct evidence confirms an intentional delay, and there are numerous arguments against Hemingway’s claim, the circumstantial evidence lends the claim more credibility than it has thus far received. Finally, this Article examines potential mechanisms for accountability and concludes that none would be actionable.

AI.tldr: 本文考察了保守派记者Mollie Hemingway关于Dobbs案中异议大法官故意拖延发布异议意见（包括通过插入脚注等方式）的指控，全面评估了该指控的时间线、证据强度和弱点，结论认为虽然没有直接证据证实故意拖延，但间接证据使该指控比此前被认为的更具可信度，同时认为任何问责机制均不可行。
AI.research_question: Dobbs案中，异议大法官是否通过一系列计算好的拖延策略（包括插入一个脚注引用未发表意见）故意延迟了多数意见的发布？Hemingway的这一指控在时间线与间接证据上是否成立？
AI.motivation: Dobbs案判决草稿泄露后，多数派大法官面临严重安全威胁（包括暗杀企图），但法院在口头辩论后205天才发布判决，远超平均时长。Hemingway指控异议大法官故意拖延，这一严重指控关系到最高法院的司法伦理和机构信誉，值得严肃学术审查。
AI.theoretical_framework: 司法决策理论、最高法院内部运作与程序惯例、司法伦理与问责机制理论
AI.method: 案例分析与文本审查方法：记录Dobbs案及其泄露事件的时间线；考察针对多数派大法官的威胁范围及政客、记者、执法部门的回应；呈现并逐项评估Hemingway的指控；对比Louisiana v. Callais案的平行争议；分析指控的单一来源性质及Hemingway可能的政治偏见；审查多数意见的空前长度、异议意见的相对重要性、脚注的必要性以及首席大法官Roberts不愿提前发布多数意见的行为。
AI.findings: 1）没有直接证据证实故意拖延；2）存在多项反对Hemingway指控的论据，包括单一来源、缺乏佐证、Hemingway可能存在的政治动机、异议意见在司法体系中的相对次要地位等；3）但间接证据（如时间线异常、平行案例对比、脚注引起的进一步延误等）使该指控获得了超出其此前所获的更多可信度；4）任何潜在的问责机制（包括弹劾或其他法律途径）均不可行。
AI.theory_contributions: 对最高法院内部决策过程与意见发布延迟的学术讨论做出了贡献；为理解最高法院大法官之间可能在安全危机背景下的政治博弈提供了新的分析框架；推进了对司法伦理、特别是异议大法官程序行为的学术审视。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公众和学界提供了一个系统性的Dobbs案延迟发布的审查框架；对最高法院的程序透明度和问责机制提出了值得关注的问题；为未来类似情况下评估司法延迟指控提供了分析路径。

title: CEO Personal Donating behavior and Corporate Social Responsibility
affiliations: University of Mississippi, University of Alabama and Liaoning University

detail.title: CEO Personal Donating behavior and Corporate Social Responsibility
detail.abstract: Using hand-collected data on CEOs' charitable donations, we show that firms led by CEOs who consistently donate exhibit significantly higher CSR performance than those led by occasional donors or non-donors. To identify causality, we examine exogenous CEO turnover events using a difference-indifferences approach and find that CSR performance increases when a non-routine-donor or non-donor CEO is replaced by a routine donor CEO and vice versa. These findings support behavioral consistency theory, indicating that CEOs' personal socially responsible behavior is indicative of their firms' CSR actions. Overall, we provide new evidence on why firms engage in CSR and identify a previously overlooked CEO attribute that helps explain CSR variation across firms.

AI.tldr: 本文利用手工收集的首席执行官（CEO）慈善捐赠数据，发现由持续捐赠的CEO领导的公司，其企业社会责任（CSR）表现显著高于偶尔捐赠或从不捐赠的CEO所领导的公司。通过外生CEO更替事件和双重差分法识别因果关系，研究支持行为一致性理论。该研究为理解企业为何参与CSR提供了新证据，并识别出一个此前被忽视的CEO特征。
AI.research_question: CEO的个人社会责任行为（慈善捐赠）是否以及如何影响其所在企业的企业社会责任（CSR）表现？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对企业为何参与CSR的解释尚不充分，且CEO个人层面的特征对企业CSR差异的解释力未被充分挖掘。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为一致性理论（Behavioral Consistency Theory）——认为个体在不同情境下的行为具有一致性，CEO个人的社会责任行为会反映在其企业决策中。
AI.method: 手工收集CEO慈善捐赠数据；采用外生CEO更替事件作为准自然实验，运用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences）识别因果关系。
AI.findings: 持续捐赠型CEO领导的企业CSR表现显著更高；当非持续捐赠型或非捐赠型CEO被持续捐赠型CEO取代时，企业CSR表现提升，反之则下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 为行为一致性理论在企业社会责任领域提供了实证支持；揭示CEO个人慈善捐赠行为这一此前被忽视的特征可作为企业CSR表现的重要解释变量；丰富了关于企业为何参与CSR的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在CEO选拔与继任决策中考虑候选人个人社会责任倾向提供依据；为企业预测和提升CSR表现提供新的参考维度。

title: Artificially Intelligent? Predicted Capability versus Observed Adoption in US Occupations

detail.title: Artificially Intelligent? Predicted Capability versus Observed Adoption in US Occupations

declarations.ethicsApproval: Note: the paper analyzes publicly released Anthropic data; the author has no affiliation with Anthropic.
declarations.funderStatement: There are no funding interests to declare.

detail.abstract: Using Anthropic's Economic Index-real AI usage mapped to O*NET taskswe characterize observed AI exposure across 756 US occupations and compare it with predicted capability. Exposure is a spike, not a wave: the median occupation shows zero observed exposure, and 86 percent of theoretically capable tasks show no observed use. Yet the spike stands on wide ground: employment-weighting raises mean exposure from 0.077 to 0.132, and roughly a quarter of covered US employment (~33 million jobs) sits in occupations where AI is observed performing over a quarter of the work-concentrated in large clerical and sales occupations, not software. Capability does not predict adoption: a permutation benchmark shows the occupation-level correlation with Eloundou et al.'s β (ρ = 0.71) is almost entirely generated by the measure's capability gate, and within the envelope, what predicts use is whether work already flows through a computer-teleworkable occupations occupy 11 points more of their envelope, while wages and capability gradations contribute little. The occupational map is robust: cross-vendor agreement with Microsoft's Copilot-based measure (0.58) matches cross-vintage agreement within Anthropic's (0.58), with category-level structure stable across both.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用Anthropic经济指数（真实的AI使用数据映射到O*NET任务）刻画了756个美国职业的AI暴露情况，发现AI暴露呈现"尖峰而非浪潮"的特征：中位数职业暴露为零，但就业加权后暴露水平显著上升，约3300万个工作岗位处于AI可执行四分之一以上任务的职业中。更重要的是，能力预测并不能解释采用率——实际采用主要由工作是否已通过计算机/远程工作流动所驱动。
AI.research_question: 真实的AI使用（而非理论能力）在不同职业间的分布如何？什么因素真正预测了AI的实际采用？
AI.motivation: 以往研究主要基于模型能力预测AI暴露（如Eloundou等人的β指标），但缺乏对真实AI使用模式的大规模实证刻画。需要用实际使用数据检验"能力是否等于采用"这一核心假设，并解释AI暴露的现实分布。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI暴露（exposure）概念框架，基于O*NET任务映射；比较"能力暴露"与"观察暴露"之间的差距；采用率理论（采用由技术能力之外的制度、工作流和基础设施因素驱动）。
AI.method: 利用Anthropic经济指数（真实AI使用数据），将其映射到O*NET任务和756个美国职业；进行就业加权分析；采用排列置换基准检验职业层面相关性；跨供应商（Microsoft Copilot）和跨时间一致性验证。
AI.findings: （1）AI暴露是尖峰而非浪潮：中位数职业观察暴露为零，86%理论上可行的任务无实际使用；（2）但尖峰站在广阔的地基上：就业加权后平均暴露从0.077升至0.132，约3300万就业岗位位于AI执行超四分之一工作的职业（集中在文员和销售，而非软件）；（3）能力不能预测采用：排列基准显示与Eloundou等人β的相关性几乎完全由能力门槛产生，在能力包络内，预测采用的是"工作是否已通过计算机流动"（远程办公职业多占11个百分点），工资和能力梯度贡献甚微；（4）职业地图稳健：与Microsoft Copilot测量的一致性（0.58）与Anthropic内部跨版本一致性（0.58）相当。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）区分了"能力暴露"与"观察暴露"两个概念，首次用大规模真实使用数据证明能力不等于采用；（2）揭示了AI采用的经济学逻辑——采用由现有工作流的技术基础（计算机/远程办公）驱动，而非能力或工资；（3）通过排列置换基准提供了方法论创新，识别出能力测量的"门槛效应"如何人为制造相关性假象。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者提供AI影响的"现实版图"：AI冲击集中在文员和销售职业（而非软件行业），提示需要针对这些职业群制定再培训和转型政策；（2）为企业提供AI部署的预测工具：判断某一职业是否会被AI采用，关键看其工作流是否已数字化、是否可远程完成；（3）为劳动力市场监测提供跨供应商验证的稳定职业暴露地图。

title: A Path to Customer-centric Marketing Mix Modeling

detail.title: A Path to Customer-centric Marketing Mix Modeling

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have nothing to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Customer-centric marketing decisions are vital for many companies to achieve sustainable customer growth. Most industry-standard solutions to the optimal marketing mix, however, focus on aggregate metrics such as revenue or orders to arrive at budget allocations across marketing channels. This disregards variations in customer quality by channel. Such a channel-centric approach might allocate budgets towards "quick-win" channels that frequently produce one-time or impulse buyers. A customer-centric approach determines how to allocate budgets across channels to attract the "right" customers, leading to more sustainable customer growth. This paper proposes concepts and methods for combining customer lifetime value calculation, insights from the customer centricity literature, and marketing mix modeling techniques to develop a framework for more customer-centric decision intelligence regarding the optimal marketing mix.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将客户终身价值（CLV）计算、客户中心化文献洞见与营销组合建模技术相结合的分析框架，以实现更以客户为中心的营销预算分配决策，替代传统以渠道为中心的优化方法。
AI.research_question: 如何将客户终身价值与客户中心化理念融入营销组合建模中，以制定更可持续的客户增长营销预算分配策略？
AI.motivation: 行业标准营销组合优化方案仅关注收入或订单等聚合指标，忽视了客户质量的渠道间差异，可能导致预算流向产生一次性或冲动购买的"速赢"渠道，不利于可持续的客户增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 客户终身价值（CLV）理论、客户中心化文献、营销组合建模（MMM）技术
AI.method: 概念框架构建与理论整合，结合CLV计算、客户中心化洞见和营销组合建模技术，形成面向决策智能的框架。
AI.findings: 提出了一个将客户终身价值与客户中心化结合起来的新型分析框架，用于更可持续的最优营销组合决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 将客户终身价值和客户中心化理念系统地融入营销组合建模框架，弥合了客户视角与渠道视角之间的理论鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了一种以客户为中心的决策智能工具，帮助企业在营销预算分配中识别和吸引"正确"的客户，从而实现更可持续的客户增长。

title: Shared Substrate: A Discipline for Sustained Human–AI Coupling on Complex Problems

detail.title: Shared Substrate: A Discipline for Sustained Human–AI Coupling on Complex Problems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This work was conducted independently; the discipline it articulates draws on the author's own practice across personal projects.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable: the paper is conceptual and involves no studies with patients or participants. The worked examples draw solely on the author's own professional practice.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Modern AI agents have characteristic limitations on long-horizon complex work: bounded context windows, drift across iterations, phantom decisions (claims of resolution not grounded in any artefact), reference rot, lost intent, and the cost of restarting cold each session. These limits will not be dissolved by larger models — they are limits of substrate, the externalised state any sustained reasoning must traverse. We articulate Shared Substrate: the discipline of forming, maintaining, and cascading hierarchical external representations across the manifestation trajectory of a project, made explicit here in response to the demands of multi-session AI collaboration. The organising image is the centroid: the participants in sustained work — the human operator, AI agents, successive model generations, colleagues — are noisy point masses in motion, and the substrate is the deliberately pinned centre of mass of that ensemble. Session drift is excursion; warm-up is reversion; the discipline is what holds the centroid stationary. The discipline rests on long-standing cognitive-science foundations — distributed cognition (Hutchins, 1995), external representations (Scaife and Rogers, 1996), cognitive load (Sweller, 1988), hierarchical levels of analysis (Marr, 1982), boundary objects (Star and Griesemer, 1989) — recovers software-engineering precedent (Architectural Decision Records (Nygard, 2011), Single Source of Truth, hexagonal architecture (Cockburn, 2005), append-only logs (Candea and Fox, 2003)) alongside emerging agentic-AI patterns (Lewis et al., 2020; Packer et al., 2024; Shinn et al., 2023; Bai et al., 2022), and is grounded formally: each abstraction layer of a project is paired with a representation formalism and a verification oracle — from executable behavioural contracts at the topmost layer to measurable non-functional envelopes at the operational one — with the work's state kept observable to the agents themselves, closing the feedback loop that enforces guardrails while divergence is still cheap to correct. The substrate that results is best understood as a compressed representation of the thing being manifested — agentic pipelines expand it into the work, and the human deposits only what no pipeline can derive — so the discipline's purpose has a one-line statement: separate genuine human creative input from cognitive load. The discipline defines six artefact categories — Knowledge Bases, Inventories, Data Dictionaries, Decision Records, Open Questions, Glossary — a status lifecycle, an edit protocol with explicit anti-patterns and a trivial-fix lane, and forward/reverse propagation rules across the hierarchy. Its posture is human-governed, agent-executed: a five-layer adoption stack progressively delegates substrate execution to agents while intent, decision, and scope authority remain with the person. The practice is domain-agnostic — software engineering appears here only as the worked instance — and practicable today with no special tooling. We claim the substrate matters as much as the model, and that this is the form of work AI raises in importance — not invents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"共享基底"（Shared Substrate）概念：一种在多会话AI协作中维持、级联分层外部表征的纪律，用于应对长时程复杂工作中AI代理的固有局限（上下文窗口受限、迭代漂移、幻觉决策等）。其核心隐喻是"质心"——人类操作者、AI代理、模型代际与协作者构成噪声质点系，基底是刻意固定的质心位置，通过纪律保持其静止。该纪律建立在分布式认知、外部表征、认知负荷等认知科学基础上，并恢复软件工程先例，形式化地以"表征形式+验证预言机"配对每一抽象层，定义六类人工制品和状态生命周期，主张"人类治理、代理执行"的五层采用堆栈。
AI.research_question: 如何通过外部化表征与分层纪律，在多会话AI协作中克服长时程复杂工作的内在限制（上下文窗口、漂移、幻觉决策、参考腐化、意图丢失等）？
AI.motivation: 现代AI代理在长时程复杂工作中具有固有局限，这些局限不会因模型规模增大而消失，而是基底（substrate）层面的问题——即持续推理必须穿越的外部化状态。需要一种系统性的纪律来管理这种外部化状态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分布式认知（Hutchins, 1995）、外部表征（Scaife & Rogers, 1996）、认知负荷理论（Sweller, 1988）、层次分析（Marr, 1982）、边界对象（Star & Griesemer, 1989）；软件工程先例包括架构决策记录、单一事实来源、六边形架构、追加日志；以及新兴代理AI模式文献。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文：通过"质心"隐喻形式化地阐述分层外部表征的纪律，将每一抽象层与表征形式和验证预言机配对，定义六种人工制品类别、状态生命周期、编辑协议与传播规则，并提出五层采用堆栈。
AI.findings: 共享基底应被视为"被展现事物的压缩表征"——代理管道将其展开为工作，人类只沉淀管道无法推导的内容。其目的可一句话概括：将人类真正的创造性输入与认知负荷分离。该纪律可行性无需特殊工具，领域无关，软件工程只是其实例。
AI.theory_contributions: 将认知科学、软件工程与代理AI模式整合为统一的理论框架；以"质心"隐喻为协作动力学提供新的形式化描述；提出"基底与模型同等重要"的论点，将外部化状态管理提升为AI协作的核心理论议题。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供六种人工制品类别的具体操作规范、状态生命周期、编辑协议（含反模式与琐碎修复通道）、前向/反向传播规则；提出人类治理、代理执行的五层采用堆栈，可在现有工具条件下实践。

title:
The Universal Consumer 

 Six Philosophical Archetypes, Their Trigger Points, and a Cross-Archetype Strategy Under the IPPO Model

detail.title:
The Universal Consumer 

 Six Philosophical Archetypes, Their Trigger Points, and a Cross-Archetype Strategy Under the IPPO Model
detail.abstract:
Beyond the Funnel argued that consumer loyalty is the product of a four-layer psychological alignment — Interest, Personality, Philosophy, Outcome — rather than the terminal stage of a purchase funnel. This companion paper operationalizes that claim by proposing six universal consumer archetypes, each with its own trigger point, tailored marketing strategy, and characteristic vulnerability, unified by a single cross-archetype discipline, the Evidence Layer, which fails in six distinct, predictable ways when applied without adaptation.
Two prior rounds of structured external review established that an archetype is a state rather than a fixed trait — varying by product category, by culture along two independent axes, and by a customer's phase within an ongoing relationship — and built out a full validation roadmap, blended-profile map, B2B applicability, macroeconomic sensitivity, and measurement framework.
This third revised edition adds five further extensions. An Archetypal Friction Threshold formalizes what happens when acute economic or personal stress forces one archetypal driver to temporarily override another, with an override-resistance ranking across the six archetypes. Behavioural-proxy diagnosis is extended from web telemetry into phygital and physical-retail signals, and into real-time generative personalization — constrained by an explicit rule that automation may change how a verified claim is phrased, never what is claimed. The lifecycle model gains a set of Decay Signals for detecting phase regression before it becomes churn. And the B2B model gains a contract-closing playbook mapping archetype-driven objections at the final negotiation stage. 
The paper closes with the IPPO Consumer Archetype Diagnostic — an eight-item forced-choice instrument for directional use — together with a scoring key, an interpretation guide, and notes on administering it per category. A companion interactive version of the same instrument is provided alongside this paper.

AI.tldr: 本文是《Beyond the Funnel》的姊妹篇，将"消费者忠诚是四层心理对齐（兴趣、个性、理念、结果）的产物"这一主张操作化，提出六大普遍消费者原型，每个原型具有触发点、定制营销策略和特征脆弱性，并由跨原型的"证据层"纪律统一。第三修订版新增五项扩展：原型摩擦阈值、行为代理诊断扩展至全渠道、生命周期衰减信号、B2B合同收尾剧本，以及IPPO消费者原型诊断工具。
AI.research_question: 如何将消费者忠诚的四层心理对齐框架（IPPO）操作化为可识别的消费者原型，并为其提供可诊断、可应用的方法论工具？
AI.motivation: 消费者忠诚不应被简单视为购买漏斗的终端阶段，而是需要更精细化的心理对齐框架。作者旨在将这一理论主张转化为实用的消费者原型分类体系，使其在营销实践中可操作、可诊断、可验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四层心理对齐模型（IPPO：Interest-Personality-Philosophy-Outcome）；消费者原型理论；证据层（Evidence Layer）跨原型纪律；原型状态理论（非固定特质，随产品类别、文化、关系阶段变化）
AI.method: 三轮结构化外部评审；前两轮构建了验证路线图、混合型画像图谱、B2B适用性、宏观经济敏感度和测量框架；第三修订版加入原型摩擦阈值、行为代理诊断（从网络遥测扩展至实体零售和实时生成式个性化）、生命周期衰减信号、B2B合同收尾剧本，以及八项迫选式诊断工具。
AI.findings: 原型是一种状态而非固定特质，会随产品类别、文化（两个独立轴）和客户关系阶段而变化；证据层在未经适配应用时存在六种不同但可预测的失败方式；六大原型具有不同的摩擦覆盖抗性排序；提出了衰减信号用于在流失前检测阶段回归。
AI.theory_contributions: 将消费者忠诚从购买漏斗末端重新概念化为多层级心理对齐的产物；提出原型作为动态状态而非静态特征的理论视角；建立了跨文化、跨情境的原型可变性框架；形式化了经济/个人压力下原型驱动力的优先级覆盖机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供六大消费者原型的触发点、定制营销策略和脆弱性识别指南；开发了可用的八项迫选式IPPO消费者原型诊断工具及评分和解释指南；提供跨全渠道的行为代理诊断方法，包括实体零售信号和实时生成式个性化（含自动化约束规则）；为B2B合同收尾阶段提供原型驱动的异议应对剧本；建立原型衰减退化信号的检测机制以预防客户流失。
